jobs.title: Manager NPD (Skincare & Haircare)
jobs.description:
**Job Title:**
Manager NPD (Skincare & Haircare)

**Location:**
New Delhi, India

**Company:**
MARS Cosmetics

**About MARS Cosmetics:**

MARS Cosmetics is a globally recognized beauty brand that thrives on innovation, diversity, and empowering individuals through high-quality beauty solutions. Headquartered in New Delhi, MARS Cosmetics is committed to offering groundbreaking products that meet the ever-evolving needs of consumers worldwide.

**Role Summary**

Own end-to-end skincare and haircare product development from concept to launch, driving formulation, packaging, claims, costing, timelines, and cross-functional execution with internal teams and 3P manufacturers.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Lead the NPD pipeline across skincare (serums, gels, emulsions) and haircare (shampoos, conditioners, masks, oils, scalp treatments, styling): identify opportunities, build briefs, define hero claims/USPs, and execute launch plans.
2. Manage formulation development with 3P labs/OEMs, from prototypes and performance benchmarks through stability, finalization, and scale-up.
3. Translate consumer problems into measurable product targets (e.g., hydration, brightening, anti-hairfall, anti-dandruff, frizz control, scalp oil control).
4. Drive packaging development: component selection (pumps, droppers, flip-tops), compatibility and leakage/transport testing, artwork readiness, and vendor coordination.
5. Own product quality and performance: sensorial targets (texture, foam, slip, rinse feel), fragrance direction, efficacy and claims substantiation inputs, safety, and QA handover.
6. Build and control timelines using stage-gates; manage risks, iterations, and stakeholder alignment.
7. Own product costing (COGS/BOM): target pricing, value engineering, MOQ planning, and margin guardrails.
8. Coordinate regulatory readiness for India, including labeling/claims compliance and documentation with RA/QA partners.
9. Benchmark competitors and global trends (actives, delivery systems, textures, formats) and convert them into actionable specs.

**Requirements**

1. 4–8 years in skincare and/or haircare NPD (brand side or OEM/ODM), with multiple launches shipped.
2. Strong formulation and packaging understanding: emulsions/gels/serums for skincare; surfactant systems, conditioning polymers, silicones, and oils for haircare; compatibility and stability basics.
3. Experience running vendor cycles with Indian/China/SEA partners, including iteration discipline, negotiation, and scale-up execution.
4. Strong project management; comfortable with BOM, COGS, MOQ, margin targets, and launch scorecards.
5. High ownership, fast execution, and strong cross-functional communication.

jobs.description:
Job Description | Mosaic Wellness Pvt. Ltd. | Research & Development
  
  
**Role at a glance**
Mosaic Wellness is hiring an Assistant Manager to own gummy and nutraceutical development, from bench formulation to commercial launch.
  
  
**Position**
Assistant Manager – Gummies & Nutraceuticals
**Function**
Research & Development (New Product Development)
**Location**
Thane West, Mumbai
**Reports to**
Head of R&D
**Experience**
6–10 years in nutraceutical R&D, including hands-on gummy development
**Education**
M.Sc. (Science) or M.Tech in a relevant discipline
**Travel**
Regular visits to CDMO and supplier sites across India
**Employment**
Full-time
  
  
**About Mosaic Wellness**
Mosaic Wellness is a Mumbai-based, digital-first health and wellness company. Its consumer brands, including Man Matters, Be Bodywise and Little Joys, serve men’s, women’s and children’s health and nutrition needs.
  
  
Our R&D team develops science-led nutraceuticals, functional foods and personal care products with manufacturing partners across India. Gummies are a key format across the portfolio.
  
  
**Role purpose**
You will own gummy and nutraceutical products end to end: formulation on the bench, scale-up at CDMOs, and a stable, compliant commercial launch.
  
  
The role solves the hard problems of the gummy format: high active loads, taste masking, sugar reduction, texture and shelf-life stability. You will be R&D’s point person for this category across brands, working closely with Brand, Quality, Regulatory, Procurement and manufacturing partners.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Formulation and product development**

* Develop gummies across gelling systems (gelatin, pectin, carrageenan, agar, starch), including vegan, sugar-free and reduced-sugar variants.
* Formulate with demanding actives: vitamins, minerals, botanicals, probiotics, prebiotic fibres and other high-load ingredients.
* Engineer taste and texture through bitterness masking, flavour and acid profiling, chew optimisation, colour stability, sanding and oil coating.
* Design out gummy failure modes: sweating, stickiness, crystallisation, syneresis, heat deformation, browning and active degradation.
* Extend expertise to other formats as needed: powders and sachets, tablets, capsules, effervescents and chewables.

Mosaic Wellness Pvt. Ltd. | Page of
  
  

* Run bench trials, Design of Experiments (DoE) and sensory evaluations, with complete lab records.

**Process development, scale-up and tech transfer**

* Define critical process parameters: cook temperature and solids (°Brix), deposit pH and temperature, deposit weight, curing conditions and final water activity.
* Lead pilot, scale-up and first commercial batches on starch mogul and starchless depositing lines at CDMO sites.
* Prepare tech-transfer packages: formula, bill of materials, process flow, Master Formula Record inputs and specifications.
* Troubleshoot weight variation, tailing, mould sticking and yield loss to deliver right-first-time commercialisation.

**Stability, quality and analytics**

* Design accelerated and real-time stability studies under ICH-aligned conditions (including Zone IVb, 30 °C/75% RH) to set overages and shelf life.
* Write raw material, packaging and finished-goods specifications; review analytical data with in-house teams and NABL-accredited labs.
* Select packaging for moisture and oxygen protection, backed by water-activity and moisture-sorption data.
* Lead root-cause analysis and CAPA for deviations, out-of-specification results and consumer complaints.

**Regulatory and documentation**

* Keep formulations and labels compliant with FSSAI’s Health Supplements and Nutraceuticals Regulations (2022), Labelling and Display Regulations (2020) and AYUSH norms where relevant.
* Check ingredient permissibility, RDA-based limits and label claims; prepare technical dossiers, including for Non-Specified Food approvals.
* Support export-market requirements (e.g., GCC, US 21 CFR) with Regulatory Affairs.

**Ingredients, partners and cost**

* Scout and qualify new ingredients, technologies and suppliers, and develop alternate sources for supply resilience.
* Assess CDMO capability and build strong technical partnerships with manufacturing and ingredient partners.
* Hit COGS targets through formulation and process value engineering, without compromising efficacy or sensory quality.

**Collaboration and team**

* Translate brand and consumer briefs into technical briefs, and deliver launches on the NPD calendar with cross-functional teams.
* Guide and mentor junior scientists, and share learnings across R&D.
* Track global gummy and delivery-format trends, and contribute to patents and scientific publications.

**What We’re Looking For**
**Education**
**One Of The Following**

* M.Sc. in Food Science and Technology, Food and Nutrition, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biotechnology or Pharmaceutical Sciences
* M.Tech in Food Technology, Food Engineering, Chemical Engineering or Pharmaceutical Technology

Mosaic Wellness Pvt. Ltd. | Page of
  
  
**Experience**

* 6–10 years in R&D or NPD for nutraceuticals, health supplements or functional foods, at a consumer brand, nutraceutical company or CDMO.
* At least 3 years of hands-on gummy development, with products taken from concept to commercial launch.
* Scale-up experience on mogul or starchless depositing lines, in-house or at a CDMO.
* A track record of stability-led formulation, setting overages and shelf life for vitamins, botanicals or probiotics.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong grasp of hydrocolloid and sugar/polyol science: gelation, pH and calcium sensitivity, glass transition, crystallisation and water activity.
* Confident with analytical data: assay and HPLC results, moisture and water activity, texture analysis and microbiology.
* Working knowledge of FSSAI nutraceutical and labelling regulations, GMP and HACCP.
* Structured experimentation (DoE), clear technical documentation and crisp reporting.
* Able to run several projects, CDMOs and stakeholders in parallel.

**Good to have**

* Experience with tablets, capsules, softgels, powders or effervescents alongside gummies.
* Probiotic, high-fibre, high-load or centre-filled gummy development.
* Work with microencapsulated actives or other novel delivery formats.
* Exposure to export regulations: US 21 CFR 111, GCC (GSO) or EU.
* Experience in a D2C or fast-growing consumer health company.
* Patents or peer-reviewed publications.
* Statistical tools such as Minitab, JMP or Design-Expert.

**What Success Looks Like In The First 12 Months**
Within a year, gummies are a dependable, scalable platform for Mosaic’s brands.
  
  

* Gummy and nutraceutical launches delivered on the NPD calendar, scaled up right first time at CDMOs.
* Every launched SKU meets label claim through shelf life, backed by robust stability data.
* Measurable COGS savings from value engineering on existing products.
* A stronger gummy platform: documented process windows, qualified alternate suppliers and fewer quality complaints.

**Why join**
You get real ownership, scientific depth and room to grow.
  
  

* Own a key format end to end, with direct influence on what reaches consumers.
* Work in a lean, decentralised R&D team where scientists own their projects and decisions sit close to the bench.
* Grow beyond gummies into nutraceuticals, functional foods and novel delivery technologies.
* Build your scientific profile through patents and publications, alongside leaders with deep global CPG experience.

jobs.title: Coffee Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Coffee Program Manager**

**About the Role:**

We're looking for a Coffee Program Manager who can do two things equally well: dream up drinks people want to talk about, and build the systems that let multiple outlets execute them exactly the same way, every time. This role does not include roasting or green coffee sourcing — that sits with our Head Roaster and Quality Team. Your world is the bar: recipes, technique, equipment, training, and the guest-facing experience across every location. This is a role for someone who gets genuinely excited about a new milk texture or extraction tweak, but who also can't stand watching a great drink get executed inconsistently three miles away.

**What You'll Own:**

**Menu & Drink Development**

● Design and test new beverages (espresso-based, batch, seasonal, non-coffee) from concept to menu-ready

● Stay ahead of trends and translate them into drinks that fit our brand and margins

● Partner with the Head Roaster and Quality Team to build drinks around each roast's strengths

● Run tastings and calibration sessions to pressure-test new recipes before rollout

**Operations & Consistency**

●
Build and maintain SOPs and recipe specs (dial-in parameters, pour ratios, milk temps, presentation) so every outlet produces the same cup

● Design and run training programs for baristas and shift leads, including onboarding and skill certification ● Set up quality-control checks (cupping, spot audits, secret-shopper visits) across all outlets

● Manage equipment standards and maintenance schedules to eliminate variance from bad kit

● Own recipe costing and pour costs; balance creativity against margin targets

**Cross-Outlet Execution**

● Visit outlets regularly to audit execution against spec, not just review reports

● Create feedback loops so issues at one location get fixed everywhere, not just patched locally

● Coordinate menu rollouts and timing across all locations so launches land together

● Assist with B2B Accounts and Quality Programs where required

● Conduct Coffee Workshops when required (Customer Facing)

**What You Bring**

● 3+ years managing a multi-location beverage or coffee program, or equivalent experience running a high-volume single site with clear ambition to scale

● A track record of drinks you've created that actually shipped and sold

● Deep hands-on espresso/bar craft — a genuinely trained palate that can dial in, identify defects, and talk origin characteristics

● Systems thinking: your default is “how do I make this repeatable,” not just “how do I make this good once”

● Comfortable building training materials, SOPs, and checklists from scratch

● Basic P&L literacy — pour cost, recipe costing, labor impact of menu decisions

● Willingness to travel regularly between outlets

**Nice to Have**

● Experience working alongside a dedicated roasting/quality team and large team of Baristas

● Competition or judging experience (barista competitions, cupping certifications)

● Experience launching a new outlet's bar program from zero

● Experience with a range of equipments such as semi-automatic and automatic

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Assistant Manager Quality Assurance to lead and manage Quality Assurance and Quality Control activities across manufacturing operations. **Qualification:** Diploma / CIPET / B.E. in a relevant technical discipline.

**Experience:** 710 years of relevant experience in Quality Assurance and Quality Control, preferably in a manufacturing environment.

jobs.description:
**Company:** CEV Engineering  
**Department:** Service & Technical Support  
**Designation:** Assistant Manager  
**Experience:** 5–8 Years (Automotive Industry Preferred)  
**Qualification:** B.Tech / Diploma in Automobile or Mechanical Engineering  
**Job Location:** Delhi NCR / Field Operations

**1. Job Purpose**

To manage CNG vehicle field issues, provide technical support to dealers, coordinate with OEM and plant quality teams, and ensure timely resolution of customer and dealer complaints. The role will focus on improving product quality, reducing warranty claims, strengthening dealer technical capabilities, and improving service performance.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Field Issue Management**

* Handle and investigate CNG vehicle technical complaints reported by dealers and customers.
* Conduct vehicle inspections and field visits to identify root causes of technical issues.
* Analyse recurring failures and prepare detailed technical investigation reports.
* Coordinate with OEM, Plant Quality, R&D, and Production teams for corrective actions.
* Monitor complaint trends and ensure timely closure of field issues.
* Escalate critical and repetitive issues to senior management.

**B. Dealer Technical Support**

* Provide technical guidance and troubleshooting support to dealer service teams.
* Plan and conduct dealer visits for technical issue resolution.
* Ensure proper CNG system inspection and repair procedures are followed.
* Support dealers in reducing unnecessary part replacement.
* Monitor dealer technical performance and identify training requirements.

**C. Warranty Management**

* Monitor CNG parts warranty claims and replacement activities.
* Analyse warranty failures and identify high-failure components.
* Coordinate with dealers for defective part return and technical investigation.
* Monitor warranty claim numbers and warranty cost.
* Work towards reducing repeat failures and unnecessary warranty claims.

**D. Technical Training & Development**

* Organise technical training for dealer technicians and service advisors.
* Develop training materials, technical manuals, and troubleshooting guides.
* Conduct practical training on CNG components and diagnostic tools.
* Evaluate dealer technicians' technical knowledge and capabilities.

**E. Reporting & Documentation**

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly field issue reports.
* Maintain a technical complaint database and track issue closure.
* Prepare 8D reports, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and Corrective Action Reports.
* Monitor KPIs related to field complaints, warranty claims, and dealer performance.
* Present technical performance and improvement plans to management.

**F. Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Coordinate with OEM Quality, Service, Plant Quality, R&D, and Production teams.
* Follow up on corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
* Support new vehicle launches and CNG system validation activities.
* Coordinate with internal teams for spare parts availability and technical support.

**3. Required Technical Skills**

* Good knowledge of CNG vehicle systems and components.
* Knowledge of CNG regulators, injectors, pressure sensors, cylinders, HP tubes, and fittings.
* Understanding of CNG diagnostics and scanning tools.
* Knowledge of vehicle troubleshooting and failure analysis.
* Understanding of warranty processes and quality tools (5 Why, Fishbone, 8D).
* Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and technical reporting.

**4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Reduction in repeat field complaints.
* Reduction in warranty claims and warranty costs.
* Timely closure of field issues.
* Dealer technical support response time.
* Number of dealer technical training sessions conducted.
* Improvement in first-time-right repair performance.
* Reduction in unnecessary part replacement.
* Timely submission of RCA and corrective action reports.

**5. Competencies Required**

* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Team management and leadership abilities.
* Effective communication and coordination.
* Decision-making and escalation management.
* Customer and dealer handling skills.
* Willingness to travel for field inspections and dealer support.

**6. Expected Deliverables**

* Timely resolution of CNG field issues.
* Improved dealer technical capabilities.
* Reduced warranty cost and repeat complaints.
* Effective coordination with OEM and plant teams.
* Improved CNG service quality and customer satisfaction.

jobs.title: R&D Domain Engineer
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

R&D Team Manager

### 

**What We Believe In**
----------------------

ABB's Process Automation business area enables customers to operate some of the world's largest and most complex industrial infrastructures, helping them outrun – leaner and cleaner.

We deliver automation, electrification, and digital solutions across process, hybrid, and maritime industries through advanced industrial software, distributed control systems, quality control solutions, and analytics technologies that accelerate digital transformation and operational excellence.

**Your Role and Responsibilities**
----------------------------------

In this role, we are looking for an R&D Engineer – System 800xA & Quality Control System (QCS) to join our Process Industries Digital Organization. You will contribute to the validation, testing, and lifecycle support of ABB System 800xA and Quality Control System (QCS) solutions, ensuring high-quality, reliable, and secure industrial automation software for the Pulp & Paper industry.

Working as part of a collaborative Agile engineering team, you will develop and execute comprehensive validation strategies, perform end-to-end system integration testing, and collaborate with Product Management, Development, Commissioning, and global R&D teams to deliver robust automation solutions while driving continuous quality improvements.

This role is contributing to the Process Industries – System 800xA & QCS Research & Development organization in Bangalore, India.

The work model for the role is: Hybrid

**You will be mainly accountable for**
--------------------------------------

* Develop and execute comprehensive validation strategies for System 800xA and Quality Control System (QCS) solutions by performing functional, integration, regression, system, cybersecurity, and end-to-end testing to ensure product quality, reliability, and compliance with ABB engineering standards.
* Validate industrial automation solutions by testing DCS integrations, QCS control strategies, process parameters, alarm management, historical data, industrial communication, and overall system performance across diverse operating scenarios.
* Collaborate with Product Management, Software Development, Commissioning, and global R&D teams to manage defect lifecycles, support release readiness, participate in Agile ceremonies, and deliver high-quality software using modern testing methodologies, Azure DevOps, and AI-assisted engineering practices.
* Drive engineering excellence by developing test automation frameworks, improving validation processes, mentoring team members, maintaining technical documentation, supporting customer demonstrations, and promoting continuous improvement initiatives.

**Qualifications for the Role**
-------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 5–10 years of experience in software testing or validation for Industrial Automation, DCS, PLC, SCADA, or Quality Control Systems, with hands-on experience in ABB System 800xA, AC 800M, and Control Builder M.
* Strong knowledge of software testing methodologies including functional, system, integration, regression, simulation, and end-to-end validation, along with experience using Azure DevOps, Git/TFS, and test automation frameworks.
* Experience with Quality Control Systems (QCS), DCS integration, industrial process control, and Pulp & Paper applications is preferred, with knowledge of IEC 61131-3 programming and industrial automation architectures.
* Understanding of Industrial Cybersecurity (IEC 62443), automated testing practices, AI-assisted testing tools, and Agile software development methodologies is considered an advantage.
* Professional certifications such as ISTQB Foundation Level or equivalent testing certifications are preferred.
* Strong analytical, communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional global teams and drive continuous quality improvement initiatives.

**More About Us**
-----------------

ABB's Process Industries business serves customers across mining, minerals, metals, cement, pulp & paper, battery manufacturing, food & beverage, and other industrial sectors by delivering integrated automation, electrification, and digital solutions that improve productivity, quality, safety, and sustainability.

Our R&D organization develops next-generation industrial automation software, distributed control systems, Quality Control Systems (QCS), cloud-enabled digital platforms, and intelligent engineering solutions that help customers optimize manufacturing processes and accelerate digital transformation. This includes preparing, submitting, and managing product registration dossiers, notifications, and applications to various regulatory bodies. **Liaison with Regulatory Agencies**: They serve as the main point of contact for regulatory authorities. This includes responding to inquiries, addressing deficiencies, and negotiating with agencies to expedite product approvals. They also represent the company at industry forums and consultations.

**Audits and Inspections**: The manager prepares for and manages internal and external audits by regulatory bodies or third-party certifiers. They ensure all facilities, processes, and documentation are inspection-ready at all times.

**Regulatory Intelligence and Risk Management**: They proactively monitor the global regulatory landscape, including new and proposed legislation, guidelines, and industry trends. jobs.description:
**Designation:** EXECUTIVE
  
**Location:** India UTTAR PRADESH Noida
  
**Group:** DS Group
  
**Entity:** Dharampal Satyapal Foods Limited
  
**SBU:** Dharampal Satyapal Foods Limited

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Position: Executive – NPD**
=============================

**New Product Development (Confectionery)**
===========================================

**Department:** Product and Technology Development (PTD)
  
**Category:** Confectionery
  
**Location:** NPD Laboratory, Greater Noida
  
**Reporting To:** Senior Manager

### **1. Job Purpose**

To support New Product Development activities in the confectionery category through hands-on laboratory work, prototype preparation, sample development, product evaluation and execution of R&D trials. The position will be primarily based in the NPD laboratory and responsible for ensuring timely preparation of quality prototypes, lab report preparation and samples as per project requirements.

### **2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Laboratory Prototype Development**

* Prepare laboratory-scale prototypes for various confectionery and its allied products as per project briefs and technical requirements.
* Execute product formulation, ingredient weighing, mixing, processing and sample preparation.
* Support the development of new product concepts, flavors, textures, shapes and variants.
* Work on product modifications and formulation adjustments based on feedback from internal stakeholders.
* Maintain consistency and reproducibility of laboratory prototypes.

**B. Sample Preparation & Management**

* Prepare product samples for internal evaluations, sensory assessments, consumer testing and customer presentations.
* Ensure proper labelling, coding, packaging and storage of prototype samples.
* Maintain sample records, formulation details and development history.
* Coordinate timely dispatch and availability of samples for different stakeholders.

**C. Laboratory Trials & Equipment Handling**

* Conduct laboratory trials using confectionery processing equipment and laboratory tools.
* Operate and maintain laboratory equipment while following established operating procedures.
* Ensure proper cleaning, sanitation and maintenance of laboratory equipment and workstations.
* Support pilot-scale and factory trials whenever required.

**D. Documentation & Data Management**

* Maintain accurate records of formulations, raw material consumption, trial observations and process parameters.
* Prepare laboratory trial reports and maintain sample tracking records.
* Update formulation sheets, trial logs and product development databases.
* Ensure proper documentation and traceability of all development activities.

**E. Raw Material & Inventory Management**

* Maintain laboratory raw material inventory and ensure availability of ingredients required for development activities.
* Monitor raw material consumption, expiry dates and storage conditions.
* Coordinate with procurement and warehouse teams for raw material requirements.
* Ensure proper handling and storage of food ingredients as per recommended conditions.

**F. Quality, Safety & Hygiene**

* Follow food safety, personal hygiene and laboratory safety practices.
* Ensure cleanliness and housekeeping of the NPD laboratory.
* Identify and report any deviations in raw material quality or laboratory processing.
* Follow established SOPs and maintain good laboratory practices.

**G. Cross-functional Coordination**

* Coordinate with NPD team members for timely execution of development projects.
* Support Marketing, Quality, Production and other stakeholders in sample preparation and product evaluation.
* Incorporate feedback from sensory evaluations and internal product reviews into subsequent prototypes.

### **3. Key Skills & Competencies**

* Hands-on experience in food product development or confectionery laboratory operations.
* Basic understanding of confectionery ingredients, formulations and processing techniques.
* Practical knowledge of weighing, mixing, heating, forming, depositing and sample preparation.
* Good observation, analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Basic computer knowledge (MS Excel, Word and PowerPoint).
* Strong attention to detail and documentation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple sample development requirements and timelines.
* Good communication and coordination skills.

### **4. Educational Qualification**

* M.Tech in Food Technology, Food Science, Dairy Technology or related disciplines.

### **5. Experience**

* **Preferred experience:** 2–5 years in Food R&D, New Product Development or laboratory operations.
* Experience in confectionery products such as gummies, jellies, hard-boiled candies, toffees, lollipops or similar categories will be preferred.
* Freshers with strong practical knowledge and relevant academic exposure may also be considered.

### **6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Timely preparation and delivery of prototype samples.
* Accuracy and consistency of laboratory formulations.
* Successful execution of assigned laboratory trials.
* Accuracy and completeness of trial documentation.
* Effective management of laboratory raw materials and inventory.
* Compliance with laboratory hygiene, safety and housekeeping standards.
* Responsiveness to internal sample development requirements.

### **7. Nature of Role**

This is a hands-on, laboratory-oriented position requiring regular involvement in prototype preparation, product development experiments, sample handling and laboratory operations. The incumbent will be primarily stationed at the NPD laboratory and will support factory/pilot and factory trials as and when required.

**Skills:**

New Product Development

Food Science

Food Technology

Lab handling

jobs.title: Manager Group Demand Planning
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

DÖHLER – WE BRING IDEAS TO LIFE.®  
Döhler is a global producer, marketer and provider of technology-driven natural ingredients, ingredient systems and integrated solutions for the global food, beverage and life science & nutrition industry. Döhler is all about mastering sensory experience and nutritional performance. Being sustainable by nature, Döhler helps to nourish the world better: Good for people – Good for planet.

 **Job Description**

The Data Scientist – Demand Planning & Supply Chain Analytics (m/f/d) is part of the Demand Planning function within Global Business Services (GBS) and is responsible for developing and improving data-driven forecasting, planning, and decision-support solutions for the assigned portfolio.  
The role combines advanced analytics, statistical modelling, and machine learning with business understanding to improve forecast accuracy, supply chain visibility, service levels, inventory performance, and planning efficiency — with particular focus on continuously improving the statistical (base) demand forecast that underpins Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP/IBP).  
The position acts as a bridge between Sales, Demand Planning, Supply Chain, Finance, IT, and business stakeholders by translating complex data into actionable insights and scalable analytical solutions.  
The role has no disciplinary responsibility and reports to the Manager Demand Planning.  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
Your Responsibilities  
1. Demand Forecasting & Advanced Analytics  

* Develop, maintain, and improve statistical forecasting and machine-learning models for demand planning.
* Integrate statistical forecasts with market intelligence, customer information, commercial input, promotions, and business assumptions.
* Analyze historical demand, trends, seasonality, outliers, demand variability, and forecast bias.
* Identify the key drivers influencing demand and quantify their impact on forecast performance.
* Evaluate and improve forecasting approaches through back-testing, scenario analysis, and model benchmarking.
* Monitor forecast accuracy, forecast value added (FVA), bias, and other relevant planning KPIs.
* Challenge forecast figures from the business, other regions, and intercompany sources using data-driven insights.
* Support the definition and implementation of Make-to-Stock, Make-to-Order, or related supply strategies through analytical recommendations.
* Develop demand scenarios, sensitivity analyses, and risk assessments to support tactical and strategic decision-making.

2. Multi-Source Demand Signal Analysis & Reconciliation  

* Provide the analytical basis for combining multiple demand signal types into one coherent base forecast, including contracted/committed volumes, Lead-to-Order (LTO) pipeline volumes, customer-specific forecasts, and material-level statistical forecasts.
* Analyze and quantify the certainty, time horizon, and granularity differences between demand signal types, and provide data-driven recommendations to support the design and calibration of the demand hierarchy/waterfall logic owned by Demand Planning.
* Identify and flag inconsistencies, double-counting, or gaps between top-down (customer/portfolio) and bottom-up (material/SKU) demand layers, and provide analysis to support their resolution.
* Analyze historical LTO pipeline conversion behavior (e.g., conversion rates, typical phase-in timing) to support appropriate probability-weighting of pipeline volumes relative to contracted volumes.
* Analyze historical patterns of how annual/yearly contract volumes split into monthly (or other sub-annual) quantities, to improve the time-phasing accuracy of contracted demand.
* Analyze and document how incoming customer orders consume the statistical/base forecast over time (forecast consumption logic), and identify opportunities to improve its accuracy and transparency.
* Analyze how push-driven (“crop-driven”) business — volume determined by raw material availability/harvest timing rather than pull demand — is incorporated into the forecast, and run dedicated analytics to improve its treatment and accuracy.

3. Data Preparation & Quality Management  

* Ensure the quality, consistency, and completeness of demand, customer, material, sales, inventory, and supply chain data.
* Perform history cleansing and establish robust processes for identifying and treating outliers, one-off events, stock-outs, and exceptional demand.
* Support the integration of new customers, materials, products, flows, and data sources into IBP and related planning systems.
* Manage and improve statistical forecast parameters, including model selection, aggregation levels, time horizons, and forecast frequencies.
* Monitor data pipelines and investigate data inconsistencies affecting planning outputs.
* Establish standards for data preparation, documentation, version control, and reproducible analysis.

4. Business Partnership & Decision Support  

* Translate business questions and planning challenges into analytical requirements and practical data science solutions.
* Interface with Sales, Account Management, Business Units, Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Finance, Controlling, and Operations on forecasting and planning topics.
* Support the analysis of business complaints relating to forecasts and new product introductions.
* Collaborate with Sales and R&D to obtain and validate LTO pipeline data at the appropriate stage of maturity for inclusion in the combined demand forecast.
* Analyze open contract quantities against call-offs and forecast figures in collaboration with Account Managers and business stakeholders.
* Support the development of a single, aligned forecast across Sales, Finance, Demand Planning, and Supply Chain.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer collaboration and create longer-term visibility of customer demand.
* Present analytical findings, assumptions, risks, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Build strong working relationships and promote data-driven decision-making across the organization.

5. Strategic Planning & Modelling  

* Develop future demand projection models to support the five-year planning process.
* Support tactical and strategic demand planning for regional capacity analysis and capacity-related conclusions.
* Perform product and customer lifecycle analysis, including new product introductions, phase-ins/phase-outs, portfolio changes, and monitoring relevant system and master-data changes.
* Support business scenario planning, including demand upside/downside scenarios, supply constraints, customer changes, and market risks.
* Identify opportunities for automation, standardization, and process improvement in demand planning and IBP.
* Develop dashboards, reports, and self-service analytical tools for planning and business stakeholders.
* Ensure analytical solutions are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with business and IT standards.

 **Qualifications**

* Completed degree in Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, Applied Economics, Industrial Engineering, or a comparable quantitative field.
* 3–5 years of professional experience in data science, advanced analytics, demand planning, supply chain analytics, forecasting, or a related field.
* Strong expertise in statistical forecasting, time-series analysis, predictive modelling, and trend analysis.
* Practical experience applying machine-learning techniques to business or supply chain problems.
* Strong programming skills in Python or R.
* Good knowledge of SQL and experience working with structured and large-scale datasets.
* Experience with data visualization and dashboarding tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent.
* Sound understanding of demand planning, IBP/S&OP, supply chain processes, inventory management, and forecast performance measurement.
* Experience working with ERP, APS, IBP, or planning sys

jobs.title: Chemical Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Title**: Chemical Engineer – Pilot Plant & Production

**Department**: Production / Pilot Plant

**Location**: Andheri East, MIDC

**Reports To**: Project Manager & Production Manager / Plant Head

**Experience**: 1–4 years

**Qualification**: B.E. / B.Tech/ M. Tech in Chemical Engineering

**Purpose of the Role**

To support the scale-up of processes from the R&D laboratory to the pilot plant, participate in the installation, inspection, commissioning and operationalization of process equipment, and thereafter supervise safe, efficient and compliant plant operations. The role is critical to achieving reliable output, yield, quality, safety, and cost targets during the transition from laboratory development to pilot-scale operations.

**Company Context**

We are scaling up a precious metal refining process from a laboratory sale to a pilot plant. The process involves glass and glass-lined reactors, corrosive chemical systems, precious metal-bearing materials, and stringent requirements for containment, material recovery, safety, and traceability.

**Key Responsibilities-**

**Pilot Plant Installation & Commissioning**

* Actively participate in the scale-up process from a laboratory sale to a pilot plant.
* Review equipment specifications, layouts, P&IDs, utility requirements, and material-of-construction suitability against process requirements.
* Verify that installed process equipment meets design, process, safety, and quality requirements.
* Participate in pre-commissioning checks such as inspection, leak testing, calibration verification, utility readiness, instrumentation checks, and trial runs.
* Support commissioning, start-up, stabilization, and performance testing of pilot-plant systems.
* Identify installation gaps, equipment issues, or process deviations and coordinate corrective actions with engineering, vendors, maintenance, and R&D teams.
* Prepare and maintain commissioning documentation, equipment logs, SOPs, batch records, and operating instructions.

**Pilot Plant Operations & Supervision**

* Plan, supervise, and execute daily pilot-plant operations as per approved batch sheets, SOPs, and production schedules.
* Operate and supervise reactor systems, ensuring correct procedures and SOPs are followed
* Monitor critical process parameters and take timely corrective action where required.
* Ensure safe handling and transfer of chemicals in the process streams.
* Maintain accurate batch records, production logs, raw-material consumption records, metal accounting inputs, and daily pilot-plant reports.
* Coordinate with R&D, Quality, Maintenance, Stores, EHS, and Dispatch to ensure smooth material flow and minimal downtime.
* Troubleshoot process deviations, equipment issues, and quality concerns; conduct root-cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Optimize yield, reduce process losses, improve equipment utilization, and support recovery of valuable materials.
* Train and supervise operators and technicians on safe operating procedures, glassware handling, emergency response and process controls.

**Safety, Compliance & Continuous Improvement**

* Ensure strict adherence to EHS requirements, statutory regulations, pollution-control norms, PPE discipline, and safe work practices.
* Ensure proper handling, storage, labeling and disposal of hazardous chemicals, process residues, and waste streams.
* Support risk assessments, HAZOP reviews, incident investigations, and management-of-change activities for new or modified equipment and processes
* Participate in ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, customer, and safety audits; close audit observations within defined timelines.
* Drive continuous improvement through Lean, 5S, Kaizen, and structured troubleshooting initiatives.
* Support new-product trials, process validation, scale-up studies, and technology transfer from R&D to pilot plant.

**Required Skills**

* Strong fundamentals of chemical engineering, including mass and energy balance, fluid flow, heat transfer, reaction engineering, and process instrumentation.
* Hands-on understanding of pilot-plant and production equipment and associated piping and utilities.
* Practical knowledge of installation checks, commissioning activities, equipment trials, and plant start-up.
* Ability to read and interpret P&IDs, equipment drawings, SOPs, batch sheets, and technical specifications.
* Understanding corrosive chemical handling, hazardous-process safety, containment, and emergency procedures.
* Familiarity with precious-metal processing will be an advantage.
* Awareness of ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 management systems.
* Good documentation, coordination, problem-solving, and team-supervision skills.
* Willingness to work at the plant site and support shift-based pilot-plant operations when required.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
**Jubilant Bhartia Group**
--------------------------

**Jubilant Bhartia Group**

Jubilant Bhartia Group is a global conglomerate founded by Mr. Shyam S Bhartia and Mr. Hari S Bhartia with strong presence in diverse sectors like Pharmaceuticals, Contract Research and Development Services, Proprietary Novel Drugs, Life Science Ingredients, Agri Products, Performance Polymers, Food Service (QSR), Food, Auto, Consulting in Aerospace and Oilfield Services. Jubilant Bhartia Group has four flagships Companies- Jubilant Pharmova Limited, Jubilant Ingrevia Limited, Jubilant FoodWorks Limited and Jubilant Industries Limited. Currently the group has a global workforce of around 56,000 employees.

**Jubilant Pharmova Limited**
-----------------------------

Jubilant Pharmova Limited (formerly Jubilant Life Sciences Limited) is a company with global presence that is involved in Radiopharma, Allergy Immunotherapy, CDMO Sterile Injectables, Contract Research Development and Manufacturing Organisation (CRDMO), Generics and Proprietary Novel Drugs businesses.

In the Radiopharma business, the Company is involved in manufacturing and supply of Radiopharmaceuticals with a network of 46 radio-pharmacies in the US. The Company’s Allergy Immunotherapy business is involved in the manufacturing and supply of allergic extracts and venom products in the US and in some other markets such as Canada, Europe and Australia. Jubilant through its CDMO Sterile Injectables business offers manufacturing services including sterile fill and finish injectables (both liquid and lyophilization), full-service ophthalmic offer (liquids, ointments & creams) and ampoules.

The CRDMO business of the Company includes the Drug Discovery Services business that provides contract research and development services through two world-class research centres in Bangalore and Noida in India and the CDMO-API business that is involved in the manufacturing of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients. Jubilant Therapeutics is involved in Proprietary Novel Drugs business and is an innovative biopharmaceutical company developing breakthrough therapies in the area of oncology and autoimmune disorders. The company operates six manufacturing facilities that cater to all the regulated market including USA, Europe and other geographies.

**The Position**
----------------

**Job** **Summary****:**

The Project Financial Analyst supports financial governance, risk management, and cost control for pharmaceutical R&D and CapEx projects, including manufacturing and equipment sourcing. This role manages multi-million-dollar budgets, ensures timely execution, and provides strategic financial analysis and reports to senior leadership. Serving as the primary financial partner to Project Managers, Engineering, Clinical Development, and Operations globally, the analyst supports financial discipline and data-driven decisions. They also collaborate with CMOs for expenditure accounting during projects.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Maintain baseline budgets during development and construction and enforce change controls to prevent unauthorized spending
* Conduct monthly variance analysis comparing actual costs to budgets and adjust for timing, price, scope, or inefficiencies
* Assist in cost estimates and tracking for new and multi-year projects while maintaining SAP records
* Update rolling cash flow and Estimate at Completion (EAC) forecasts and monitor cost and schedule performance
* Identify financial risks early and create dashboards with KPIs to alert teams and management
* Present monthly and quarterly variance reports explaining financial impacts of delays
* Track contingency funds and reserves throughout pharmaceutical development and construction
* Monitor contractor billings, equipment, and vendor costs to prevent cost overruns
* Oversee Construction in Progress (CIP) account tracking and transition to fixed assets
* Provide monthly reports on profitability, cash flow, and R&D tax credits
* Support procurement in managing vendor agreements, change orders, and invoice compliance

**Main Responsibilities / Job Summary**

Ensure the achievement of department objectives and monitor product cost, quality, and timeliness as per production / delivery plan.

Ensure all production / filling-packing lines have high operational performance and process capability to deliver products as per established standards.

Plan and coordinate all maintenance activities viz. routine, periodic maintenance and CIP / shutdown activities.

Establish and implement a maintenance strategy and schedule supported by all functions thereby ensuring availability of lines / plant (production and infrastructure) to ensure optimum utilisation of assets and resources.

Ensure product and process compliance in line with Nestlé policies, standards and legal requirements.

Ensure work place safety and effective communication of Safety, Health and Environment to all team members.

Conduct inspection / audits and investigate incidents to close gaps.

Ensure good and hygienic engineering practices are applied at all times.

Coach / train, with related parties, the technicians and operators in preventive / routine maintenance activities and machinery operations.

Ensure that CDM is fully integrated with factory operations and all operators / technicians understand and practice CDM.

Measure, analyse and improve line performance by using available systems / tools (AMM etc.)

Contribute to establishing energy and line standards.

Sora Foods Pvt. Ltd. is looking for an experienced and result-oriented **Head Chef / Production Head** to lead and manage overall food production and kitchen operations.

The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in large-scale food production, central kitchen operations, food manufacturing, recipe standardisation, production planning, team management, quality assurance and cost control.

The candidate will be responsible for ensuring consistent food quality, timely production, operational efficiency, hygiene standards and smooth coordination across all production activities.

* Supervise large-scale food preparation, cooking, processing, packing and dispatch.

* Develop and implement standard operating procedures (SOPs) for production activities.

* Prepare production plans based on sales forecasts, purchase orders and inventory availability.

**3. Recipe Development & Menu Standardisation**

* Develop new recipes, food products and menu items.

* Establish food costing, portion control and standard yield calculations.
* Conduct product trials, tasting sessions and quality evaluations.
* Continuously improve product quality, taste, shelf life and production efficiency.

**4. Quality Control & Food Safety**

* Ensure compliance with FSSAI regulations and food safety standards.
* Maintain high standards of hygiene, sanitation and kitchen cleanliness.
* Monitor raw material quality and finished product quality.
* Implement quality checks at every stage of production.
* Ensure proper storage, temperature control, labelling and FIFO/FEFO practices.
* Coordinate with the Quality Assurance team for audits, inspections and corrective actions.

**5. Cost Control & Waste Management**

* Control food production costs, raw material consumption and operational expenses.
* Monitor food costing, recipe costing and production yields.
* Reduce food wastage, rejection, spoilage and unnecessary consumption.
* Improve production efficiency without compromising food quality.
* Track actual consumption against standard consumption.

**6. Team Management & Leadership**

* Lead, train and manage chefs, kitchen supervisors, cooks and production staff.
* Allocate responsibilities and monitor individual and team performance.
* Prepare manpower requirements and duty schedules.
* Conduct regular training on cooking techniques, hygiene, food safety and SOPs.
* Maintain discipline, accountability and productivity across the production team.

**7. Reporting & Coordination**

* Prepare daily production reports and management MIS.
* Track planned vs. actual production.
* Monitor raw material consumption, wastage, rejection and finished goods output.
* Coordinate with procurement, quality, warehouse, logistics and operations teams.
* Report production challenges, operational issues and improvement opportunities to management.

Required Qualifications

* Diploma / Degree in Hotel Management, Culinary Arts, Food Production or a relevant field.
* 8–12+ years of relevant experience in food production, central kitchens, food manufacturing or large-scale kitchen operations.
* Prior experience in handling high-volume food production is mandatory.
* Strong knowledge of food safety, hygiene standards and FSSAI requirements.

* Problem-Solving & Decision-Making

Qualification: M.Tech / B.Tech - Dairy Technology / Food Technology / Food Science or similar qualification.

Experience: 4 - 8 Years

Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat

**Job Description:**

**Production & Process Management :**

* **End-to-End Production:** Supervise daily cheese production activities including milk standardization, pasteurization, curd preparation, cutting, molding, pressing, salting, and ripening.
* **Process Standardization:** Design and standardize critical processing parameters such as temperature, pH, coagulation, curd stretching, and syneresis (moisture control) to ensure product consistency.
* **Equipment Operations:** Operate, troubleshoot, and validate pilot-scale and industrial cheese-making equipment including cheese vats, separators, molders, and brining systems.

**Research, Development & Innovation (R&D)**

* **New Product Development:** Conceptualize, formulate, and commercialize new cheese varieties, including Mozzarella, Cheddar, Processed, Gouda, Brie, and regional artisanal cheeses.
* **Experimentation:** Innovate with adjunct cultures, enzymes, emulsifiers, and stabilizers to create differentiated flavor profiles and optimize product texture.
* **Yield Optimization:** Collaborate with production teams to scale lab trials to commercial levels while optimizing yield, cost efficiency, and quality consistency.

**Affinage (Cheese Ripening & Aging)**

* **Climate Control:** Manage cheese caves and aging facilities by strictly monitoring curing conditions like humidity (often above 90%), temperature (usually around 10°C), and aeration to promote proper microbial activity.
* **Maturation:** Turn, rotate, and apply surface treatments or washes to cheeses at appropriate intervals to maximize optimal drainage, even ripening, and flavor development.

**Quality Assurance & Food Safety Compliance**

* **FSSAI Compliance:** Ensure all formulations, packaging, and labeling comply strictly with FSSAI regulations and international food safety standards.
* **Safety Protocols:** Monitor Critical Control Points (CCP) in compliance with food safety frameworks like FSSC 22000 and HACCP.
* **Hygiene & Sanitation:** Maintain strict hygiene standards, assess environmental impact, and supervise Clean-In-Place (CIP) and manual sanitation protocols in the production area.
* **Testing:** Collaborate with the Quality Assurance team to conduct sensory evaluations, organoleptic testing, and monitor chemical/microbial properties.

**Leadership & Administration**

* **Team Management:** Train, supervise, and guide production operators and junior staff on best practices in cheese handling and safety.
* **Documentation:** Document experimental data, daily production reports, batch records, and formulation processes accurately for audits and traceability, utilizing tools like SAP or other ERP modules.

jobs.title: Manager Culinary Development

**Job Purpose**
Join our Catering team, where you will be part of an exciting business area that plays a vital role in delivering the Emirates ‘Fly Better’ experience. This team is responsible for a wide range of food and non-food functions, including catering, equipment, and amenities for inflight dining and special events.

As a key part of our Service Delivery operations, our catering team makes crucial decisions that enhance the customer experience and elevate our growing global brand.
  
  
As a
**Manager Culinary Development,**
you will manage the recipe, dish and menu design process to ensure Emirates remains at the forefront of global culinary trends and innovation. You will lead a centralised Culinary Development Centre of Excellence, responsible for creating, maintaining and governing the Emirates recipe bank. Working in collaboration with key stakeholders and leveraging customer insights and data, you will plan and develop network-wide menus that consistently delight our guests.
  
  
Additionally, you will plan and deliver Dubai-based culinary workshops focused on educating Emirates' global inflight and premium lounge catering partners on menu and dish preparation. In addition, you will oversee Emirates-owned food and beverage products, while developing and managing Emirates-nominated food suppliers to ensure the highest standards of quality, consistency and culinary excellence across the network. We are hiring for two distinct roles, each requiring specialist expertise in either North and South American cuisine development and innovation, or the development, standardisation and management of Special Meals (SPMLs), including Child, Medical, Religious and Allergen-Sensitive Meals.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will Be**

* Accountable for the planning and day to day management of the EK Culinary Centre of Excellence ensuring that annual targets of blue-sky cuisine innovations and individual dish creations are exceeded.
* In collaboration with the Service design team, responsible for supporting the decision making for flight/cabin level meal service standards.
* Accountable for the creation and development of detailed recipes that are conducive to performing optimally in the EK, network wide catering partner facilities.
* Responsible for documenting and version controlling all EK recipes and production methods in the EK owned, catering management system.
* In collaboration with the Regional Catering Management and Business Insights teams, accountable for station level menu planning ensuring customers’ expectations are exceeded.
* Accountable for planning and executing regular Dubai based, global inflight supplier culinary workshops to ensure that the education of individual dish and menu creations are understood and consistently translated around the EK network.
* Accountable for the product development life cycle management of EK owned, category specific, food and beverage items.
* Accountable for developing the EK centralised, nominated food and beverage suppliers to ensure that we are able to constantly improve our speed to market and efficiency gains.
* Responsible for identifying and developing food and beverage promotional and celebratory initiatives to effectively promote and market EKs award winning offering.
* Responsible for carrying out regular industry benchmarking across all hospitality sectors to ensure that EK remains at the forefront of food and beverage innovation.

Qualification
  
  
**To be considered for this role, you must meet the below requirements:**
**Qualification**

* An attested degree (12+3) or equivalent work experience.
* Culinary apprenticeship is preferred.

**Experience**

* 10+ years in culinary development, fine dining, hospitality R&D, or large-scale production. Airline catering experience preferred.
* Demonstrated expertise in the development, innovation and standardisation of menus and recipes featuring North and South American cuisines, with in-depth knowledge of regional culinary traditions, authentic cooking techniques, emerging food trends, ingredient selection, nutritional principles, portion control and cost optimisation, ensuring culinary authenticity, consistency and alignment with diverse passenger preferences.

* And/or
* Demonstrated expertise in the development, innovation, standardisation and management of Special Meals (SPMLs), including Child, Medical, Religious and Allergen-Sensitive Meals, supported by sound knowledge of nutrition, dietary principles, menu engineering, allergen management and religious and cultural food requirements, ensuring nutritional suitability, recipe consistency and alignment with diverse passenger needs.

**Knowledge & Skills**

* Comprehensive knowledge of and passion for, global cuisines, emerging culinary trends, and evolving guest preferences.
* Deep expertise in recipe development, standardisation, and large-scale recipe upscaling.
* Strong understanding of airline catering operations, including large-scale production, cook-chill processes, and the associated operational challenges and considerations.
* Proven ability to train, coach and educate colleagues and external catering partners on recipe execution and individual dish preparation.
* Confident and engaging presenter, with the ability to communicate with credibility and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organisation.
* Highly organised with strong planning, prioritisation, and project management capabilities.
* Demonstrated ability to perform effectively under pressure and manage competing priorities within tight timeframes.

At Emirates, we're committed to providing our employees with opportunities to grow and develop in their careers. So if you're looking for a challenging and rewarding opportunity, apply today and join our team!
  
  
Salary & benefits
  
  
Join us in a management role and enjoy an attractive tax-free salary. On top of our generous travel benefits, including discounted flights and hotel stays around the world, this managerial role also offers an excellent leave and healthcare package. That's in addition to transport benefits, life insurance and much more.
  
  
Discover what it's like to live and work in our fast-paced, cosmopolitan home city of Dubai and build a rewarding career with Emirates!

**Job Description**
**Job Purpose**
A brand custodian with responsibility and accountability for designing and executing the local brand strategy and marketing activities that deliver specific brand objectives, including NSV and penetration targets, in alignment with the global framework.
  
  
The brand manager must have the experience, expertise and skill set to develop an optimum calendar in local market, while ensuring excellence in execution on ground.
  
  
The role also leads innovation across the chocolate portfolio. The brand manager is the go-to person for identifying and valuing new opportunity spaces, building the business case, validating it with consumers and working with factories and co-manufacturers to take the right ideas from concept to launch.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**
**Own & manage the brand**

* Analyze the category and brand performance and identify whitespace opportunities to accelerate growth.
* Set the brand's short and long term strategy to deliver quality growth and growing penetration.
* Manage budget and resources effectively to deliver marketing/activity calendar
* Connect with cross functional teams to support creation of an integrated business plan that ensures delivery of key initiatives in market
* Create and develop the local market brand marketing plan and activity calendar, and manage budget and resources to deliver it.

**Deliver market relevant brand content**

* Leverage the right global content when relevant & work with the content team & media team to find the most effective ways to support the brand
* Ensure content & executions are consistent with global brand guidelines and are locally relevant

**Manage & deliver projects & activities**

* Co-lead with the activity management team a cross functional ATG team to collect all inputs required to deliver a 3-year activity plan including media plans, NPIs, BPIs, consumer promotions and other national activities.

**Lead innovation across the portfolio**

* Identify and map opportunity spaces across chocolate brands and markets, using category, consumer and competitor data.
* Size and value each opportunity (size of prize, MAC, GM%, incrementality) and recommend which to pursue.
* Validate the right innovations with consumers through various market research methods
* Build the business case and present it at stage gates to secure resources and leadership alignment.

Bachelor's degree in a relevant field; Master's is a plus.

Track record of owning and growing large-scale brands; strong strategic, commercial and analytical acumen.

Middle East & Africa experience a plus, with focus on GCC/Egypt.

jobs.title: Marketing Director - Innovation, Menu & Markets - KFC MENA
jobs.description:
**Location: Al Rayyan Tower, Al Nahda, Sharjah(Border of Dubai & Sharjah)**

**Job Purpose:**

We are seeking a hands-on Marketing Director of Innovation, Menu & Markets to grow KFC, the biggest chicken brand in the region, across the GCC, Levant and Morocco. This role is pivotal in leading the day-to-day marketing operations and the innovation agenda for the brand across all operating markets. The role owns the innovation pipeline, the menu architecture and the end-to-end execution of locally relevant marketing windows in every market, across dine-in, drive-thru and aggregator channels.

Provide advisory and center-of-excellence support to other markets as required. This includes strategic guidance during critical situations, recovery planning and support on key initiatives, such as strengthening menu and NPD plans, in collaboration with local teams.

**The right person is a true hustler: hands-on, action-oriented and relentless on execution, with a strong food palate, the ability to bring diverse stakeholders along, and a proven record of leading high-performing teams to drive operational and commercial excellence across markets.**

**Key Responsibility Areas:**

**Strategic Leadership: Future-proof the brand across Customer, Commercials, Competitiveness & Channels**

* Spot key customer and food trends early and shape brand strategy through relevant actions built into the 18-month plan that rolls into the AOP.
* Develop and execute an overarching marketing AOP that delivers on the brand’s strategic objectives across the geography.

**Market Windows & Execution Excellence: Own the local calendar, end to end**

* Own the planning and execution of locally relevant marketing windows in every market (e.g. Ramadan, Eid, National Days, summer, back-to-school and key sporting and cultural moments), tailoring offer, price and communication to each market.
* Deliver flawless, on-time launches from concept to restaurant, covering product readiness, supply, training, POS, digital and aggregator activation, and close gaps with speed and minimal escalation.
* Run a disciplined launch cadence with clear timelines, owners and post-launch reviews; read results fast, fix what is not working and scale what is.
* Maintain a strong, hands-on presence in markets and restaurants to ensure plans land as intended and learnings are captured and shared across markets.

**Stakeholder Management: Build alignment and get things done**

* Drive cross-functional collaboration with stakeholders, including but not limited to the Franchisor, country GMs and Operations, Finance, Supply Chain, R&D, Procurement and other business units, to deliver cohesive and impactful NPD and market initiatives.
* Build strong, trust-based relationships with country leadership teams; balance regional consistency with local market needs and negotiate trade-offs to land the best outcome for the brand.
* Manage agency, supplier and aggregator partner relationships to deliver high-quality work on time and within budget.

**Menu & NPD Leadership: Bring a strong food palate to every decision**

* Own the menu strategy and architecture across core, value, premium and limited-time offers, ensuring a balanced, profitable menu tailored to each market.
* Lead the culinary innovation agenda to enhance brand love and relevance, driving customer penetration and frequency through sustainable new product platforms.
* Bring a strong, discerning food palate to product development: lead taste panels, kitchen sessions and product sign-offs with R&D and suppliers, and push for products that win on taste, quality and consistency.
* Translate local flavor preferences and culinary trends into a robust NPD pipeline that is operationally feasible and commercially viable.

**Fortify & Future-Proof Brand Connect: Modernize the brand**

* Actively guide all local market actions to embed the brand in local culture while retaining its global stature.
* Ensure brand consistency and quality across all market communication and activations.

**Digital Marketing Excellence: Build a digitally native brand, in line with the customers of the future**

* Manage and leverage the aggregator channel to maximize revenue while delivering profitability objectives.
* Design market programs that shift customers towards dine-in and drive-thru habits.

**Financial Outcomes: Deliver profitable growth**

* Continue to deliver industry-leading financial outcomes.
* Be accountable for commercial outcomes (transactions, average transaction value, sales and gross profit) for the brand in every operating country.
* Plan, monitor and adhere to resource allocation within budget, in line with Annual Operating Plan guidelines, and coach the team to do the same.
* Work with cross-functional teams to build a strong data- and learning-based marketing investment culture.

**Insights and Analytics: Role-model the use of data, while staying curious to spot trends that future-proof the brand**

* Use consumer research programs to refine the consumer model, conduct competitor analysis, track consumer habits and initiate product improvements to meet market needs.
* Leverage insights from dedicated brand analysts to inform decision-making, optimize innovation and address menu gaps.

**Team Leadership: Build an enviable, high-performing, cohesive working environment**

* Lead and manage a diverse, multi-disciplinary team across all eight operating markets: onboard, coach and mentor team members, set clear goals and hold the team accountable for delivery.
* Provide functional leadership to the team, fostering a culture of collaboration, ownership and innovation.
* Lead the brand agenda among cross-functional teams to accelerate delivery of the brand’s strategic objectives.
* Role-model Americana people practices and coach the team to build a strong talent bench.
* Be a strong advocate for the customer agenda within the KFC leadership team and a mentor for cross-functional teams.
* Be a flag bearer for Americana’s purpose, vision and strategy, instilling an ownership mindset and a bias for action.

**Qualifications and Experience:**

* 10–15 years of marketing leadership experience.
* Experience in QSR or retail is a must-have.
* Proven track record of managing marketing for multi-country, multi-channel portfolios in complex, high-transaction environments such as KFC or other global brands.
* Demonstrated success in owning and executing locally relevant campaigns and seasonal windows across multiple markets, on time and to a high standard.
* A strong food palate and genuine passion for food, with hands-on experience in menu management, NPD and product sign-off.
* Expertise in building brand love to drive both customer penetration and frequency.
* Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and align senior leaders, the franchisor, country teams and cross-functional partners.
* A hustler mindset: hands-on, resourceful, comfortable with ambiguity and driven to get things done at pace.
* Strong analytical and commercial mindset with the ability to interpret and act on data insights.
* Exceptional leadership and team management skills, with a proven ability to build future leaders while driving performance in cross-functional teams.

jobs.description:
Job Purpose

The Purchase Manager is responsible for managing, coordinating, and monitoring purchasing activities across Roast, Cha Cha Chai, and ZAD Food Store.

The role involves working closely with Operations Managers, Outlet Managers, and other concerned employees to identify purchasing requirements, source suitable suppliers, negotiate competitive pricing, ensure product quality, monitor supplier performance, and maintain proper purchasing procedures and documentation.

The Purchase Manager is expected to ensure that all outlets obtain the required products and materials at competitive prices, with the right quality and timely delivery, while maintaining cost efficiency and accountability throughout the purchasing process.

Key Responsibilities1. Purchase Coordination

* Coordinate with Operations Managers and Outlet Managers to understand daily, weekly, and operational purchasing requirements.
* Ensure purchasing requirements are properly communicated, planned, and fulfilled on time.
* Follow up on pending orders, deliveries, shortages, and urgent requirements.
* Ensure outlets purchase products from approved suppliers wherever applicable.
* Monitor purchasing activities across all brands and identify unnecessary, duplicate, or excessive purchases.
* Support outlets in sourcing products whenever required.
* Coordinate purchases for new outlets, menu launches, promotions, and special operational requirements.

2. Supplier Sourcing & Negotiation

* Identify and develop new suppliers for food products, beverages, packaging, cleaning materials, equipment, and other F&B operational requirements.
* Regularly obtain quotations from suppliers and compare prices, quality, delivery terms, and payment conditions.
* Negotiate competitive prices, discounts, credit terms, delivery charges, and other commercial benefits.
* Develop alternate suppliers for key products to avoid dependency and supply disruptions.
* Maintain an updated supplier database with contact details, product specifications, pricing, payment terms, and delivery conditions.
* Establish professional relationships with suppliers and maintain effective communication.
* Conduct regular market research to identify competitive suppliers and better purchasing opportunities.

3. Cost Control & Price Monitoring

* Monitor prices of frequently purchased products across all outlets and brands.
* Maintain updated price comparison records for major food ingredients and operational supplies.
* Identify opportunities to reduce purchasing costs without compromising product quality.
* Monitor supplier price increases and verify whether such increases are justified based on market conditions.
* Inform Management and Operations of significant price changes affecting food cost and profitability.
* Negotiate better pricing based on purchasing volume, frequency, and long-term business relationships.
* Identify opportunities for savings through alternative products, suppliers, packaging, and purchasing arrangements.

4. Coordination With Operations & Outlet Managers

* Work closely with Operations Managers and Outlet Managers to ensure purchasing requirements are fulfilled efficiently.
* Understand outlet consumption patterns, menu requirements, operational priorities, and product specifications.
* Coordinate with Operations before changing suppliers, brands, product specifications, or ingredients.
* Ensure new suppliers and products are evaluated and approved by the concerned Operations team before implementation.
* Resolve supplier-related issues affecting outlet operations.
* Ensure purchasing decisions support operational requirements without compromising service, product quality, or customer experience.

5. Supplier Performance & Quality Control

**Job Title:** Retail Sales Lead

**Industry** - FMCG / Snacking / Food & Beverages / Confectionery

**Role Overview**

The Retail Sales Lead will own the UAE retail business across distributors and retailer accounts. The role combines sales, distribution, trade marketing, merchandising, account management, commercial planning, and P&L ownership. The candidate will work closely with distributors and key retail partners to build joint business plans, drive sell-in and sell-out, improve distribution and visibility, and ensure strong execution across stores and channels.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Retail Sales & Key Account Management**

 Own sales and business development across assigned UAE retail accounts, including modern trade, supermarkets, hypermarkets, convenience, specialty retail and other relevant channels.

 Build and maintain strong commercial relationships with retailer buying, category, trade marketing and merchandising teams.

 Lead commercial negotiations covering listings, pricing, promotions, visibility, trade terms, displays, launches and annual business plans.

 Develop account-level sales plans and deliver monthly, quarterly and annual revenue targets.

 Track sell-in, sell-out, stock levels, distribution, rate of sale and promotional performance by account.

**2. Distributor Management & Distribution**

 Manage company's UAE distributor relationships and act as the primary commercial interface between the company, distributor and retail accounts.

 Set distributor targets, channel plans, assortment priorities, inventory norms and execution KPIs.

 Build Joint Business Plans (JBPs) with distributors covering revenue, distribution, new listings, promotions, inventory, working capital and marketing investments.

 Review distributor performance regularly and drive corrective actions where required.

 Ensure effective order planning, stock availability, replenishment and distribution across priority retail outlets.

 Monitor distributor inventory, ageing, returns, expiries and receivables to protect business economics.

**3. P&L & Commercial Ownership**

 Own and manage account/channel-level commercial P&Ls and understand revenue, gross margin, trade spends, discounts, promotional investments and contribution economics.

 Track actuals versus budget and identify opportunities to improve revenue quality and profitability.

 Evaluate promotional ROI, retailer investments, listing fees, visibility spends and distributor margins.

 Work with finance and management on forecasts, budgets, sales plans and commercial decisions.

**4. Trade Marketing & Joint Business Planning**

 Develop retailer-specific and distributor-specific annual and quarterly Joint Business Plans.

 Plan and execute trade marketing calendars across promotions, launches, sampling, activations, displays and in-store visibility.

 Coordinate with marketing teams to translate brand campaigns into effective retail execution.

 Identify category growth opportunities and recommend relevant activations, offers and visibility initiatives.

 Measure the commercial impact of trade marketing investments and continuously improve ROI.

**5. Merchandising & In-Store Execution**

 Own in-store visibility and merchandising standards across key retail accounts.

 Ensure correct shelf placement, planogram compliance, secondary displays, POSM deployment, pricing visibility and promotional execution.

 Conduct regular market/store visits and identify gaps in availability, visibility, pricing and execution.

 Work with distributors and merchandising teams to close execution gaps quickly.

 Build a strong understanding of the UAE retail landscape, including store formats, shopper behaviour and category dynamics.

**6. New Business Development**

 Identify and open new retail, convenience, specialty and institutional opportunities relevant to company.

**JOB OVERVIEW**

We are looking for a driven, field-based Field Sales Executive to join our Sales team in the UAE. This is a hands-on sales role focused on introducing Sapaad’s technology solutions to businesses across the food and beverage industry.

This is a true door-to-door sales role. You will proactively visit businesses, meet owners and managers face-to-face, present the value of Sapaad’s solutions, and convert prospects into customers.
