jobs.title: Application Chemist
jobs.description:
#### ***Toshvin Analytical is a place where opportunity meets growth. We believe in providing the best quality service to our clients and in turn, helping businesses grow. We are a team of experienced professionals, looking for bright, motivated and committed individuals.***

#### ***If you are interested in a long-term career with one of the leading instrumentation companies in India, please email your CV to:*** ***careers@toshvin.com***

  

**Position :** Application Chemist

**Reports to :** RM / SM

**Location :** Bangalore

**Minimum Years of Work Experience :** 2 years

**Maximum Years of Work Experience :** 8 years

**Minimum Qualification :** B.Sc. or equivalent Graduation in Organic Chemistry or Analytical Chemistry

**Prefered Qualification :** M.Sc. Or Equivalent Postgraduation in Organic/ Analytical Chemistry or higher

**Maximum Grade in Toshvin :** M1

**Type of Work Experience Required:** Experience in Chromato products

**Type of Work Experience Required:** Experience in GC, GCMS

**Responsibilities & Deliverables:**

* Responsible for providing post sale customer on-site application support on GC, GCMS & GCMS-MS
* Supporting customer method development / method optimisation assistance pertaining to their sample matrices
* Helping customer with method validation support , Trouble shooting of customers application issues
* Demonstrating to customers advanced software capabilities and method packages with sample matrices
* Coordinate with Principals local application lab for any support required to address any unresolved customers application requests
* Conducting application training to customers chemists for effective use and utilization of the system and software
* Preparing effective application support reports detailing activities carried out and final result achieved
* Preparing and making PowerPoint presentations as and when required to customer on application support activity carried out and result achieved

**General Success Behaviours:**

* **Accountability:** Takes ownership of tasks and responsibilities
* **Collaboration & Teamwork:** Works effectively with others across teams and departments
* **Communication:** Communicates clearly, effectively and professionally
* **Customer & Stakeholder Focus:** Understands the internal and external customer needs
* **Integrity & Ethics:** Acts honestly, maintains confidentiality and upholds company values
* **Results Orientation:** Works proactively, manages time to meet deadlines and priorities
* **Professionalism:** Upholds professional standards and represents the organisation positively
* **Organizational Awareness:** Keeps updated on the organization’s goals and industry trends

**Any specific skills/knowledge required for this position:**

* **1. Chromatography Expertise:**
* Hands-on experience in handling chromatography products such as Gas Chromatography (GC), GC with Headspace (GC-HS), Gas Chromatography–Mass Spectrometry (GC-MS), and Triple Quad Mass Spectrometry (GC-MS/MS). Should be comfortable in operating, troubleshooting, and maintaining these instruments
* Should have handled & managed reasonably sized field sales team members (4 to 5 & more) and also Managers (managing their team)
* **2. Sampling Techniques:**
* Familiarity with advanced sampling techniques such as Headspace Samplers, Thermal Desorption Units, Pyrolyzers, and other front-end sample introduction systems
* **3. Analytical Methodology:**
* Proven experience in analytical method development, optimization, and validation using GC, GC-MS, and GC-MS/MS platforms. Ability to design robust methods to address complex analytical challenges and ensure reproducibility
* **4. Application Knowledge by Industry Segment:**
* Understanding of typical application workflows aligned with specific industry requirements (e.g., pharmaceuticals, food & beverages, environmental, petrochemicals, forensic, or clinical research). Should be able to translate customer requirements into analytical solutions
* **5. Regulatory Knowledge:**
* Awareness of global regulatory standards and compliance requirements such as US FDA, EPA, ICH, USP, GLP, and ISO guidelines. Prior experience in working under regulated environments would be highly desirable
* **6. Sample Preparation Techniques:**
* Well-versed with diverse sample preparation methods including extraction (liquid-liquid, solid-phase), digestion, purification, derivatization, and clean-up techniques. Understanding of how these steps impact final analytical results is essential
* **7. Additional Desirable Skills:**
* a. Ability to handle complex data analysis and interpret mass spectral information. b. Familiarity with software platforms used in GC/GC-MS/GC-MS/MS workflows. c. Strong problem-solving aptitude with innovative thinking for method troubleshooting. d. Effective technical communication skills to support customers, teams, and training sessions

jobs.description:
**Job Requirements**  

“We Power the Magic!” That’s our motto at Disney Experiences (DX). Our team creates world-class immersive digital experiences for the Company’s premier vacation brands including Disney’s Parks & Resorts worldwide, Disney Cruise Line, Aulani, a Disney Resort & Spa, and Disney Vacation Club.

The Lead Tech Project Manager is a skilled, experienced subject matter expert who leads complex technology initiatives that bring Disney Experiences’ immersive stories to life across theme parks, resorts, cruise, vacation, travel, retail, and consumer touchpoints. As a Lead Tech Project Manager, you will serve as a lead and mentor for project teams, driving high-priority initiatives that support Disney Experiences’ technology and digital ecosystem across guest-facing and consumer channels. jobs.title: Restaurant Purchase & Stores
jobs.description:
Store & Purchase Executive

**Churchgate Hospitality Pvt. Ltd. | Mumbai | Full-time | On-site**

Company Description

Churchgate Hospitality Pvt. Ltd. (CHPL) is a hospitality-led brand house focused on creating distinct, experience-first dining concepts. Each restaurant is built with a clear identity, rooted in culture, refined through design, and elevated by attentive service and strong culinary execution.

The portfolio includes **Nksha**, an Art Deco-inspired North Indian fine dining concept; **Otoki**, a refined Japanese dining experience defined by precision and authenticity; **Tamak**, a bold North Indian concept centred on warmth and social dining; and **Fieno**, a contemporary Italian restaurant celebrating regional Italian cooking, quality ingredients and warm, refined hospitality.

CHPL approaches restaurant development as brand building rather than outlet expansion, ensuring each concept remains distinctive in character, culinary identity and guest experience.

Role Description

The **Store & Purchase Executive** is a full-time, on-site role based in Mumbai, responsible for procurement, receiving, inventory control and store operations across Churchgate Hospitality's restaurant portfolio.

The role works closely with chefs, restaurant managers, finance and vendors to ensure uninterrupted availability of food, beverage, packaging, operating supplies and other restaurant requirements while maintaining appropriate quality, pricing and stock levels.

The Store & Purchase Executive will manage purchase orders, vendor quotations, inward documentation, stock movements and periodic physical inventories. The role requires strong attention to **purchase prices, yields, wastage, consumption patterns and stock variances**, with timely reporting of discrepancies or unusual movements.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage daily and periodic **purchase requirements** across CHPL restaurants.
* Consolidate outlet indents and issue purchase orders based on approved requirements.
* Obtain and compare **multiple vendor quotations** to maintain competitive pricing and consistent specifications.
* Maintain approved vendor lists and negotiate pricing, credit terms, delivery schedules and product specifications.
* Coordinate closely with chefs and operations teams on availability and specifications of fresh produce, meat, seafood, dairy, imported ingredients, beverages and dry goods.
* Monitor purchase rates and immediately flag **significant price increases or supplier changes**.
* Receive materials and verify **quantity, quality, weight, specification, batch, expiry and condition** against purchase orders and invoices.
* Ensure strict **FIFO/FEFO** stock rotation and appropriate storage temperatures and conditions.
* Maintain GRNs, purchase orders, invoices, stock-transfer records, return notes and other store documentation.
* Maintain accurate records of **opening stock, inward, outward/issue, transfers, closing stock and consumption**.
* Conduct regular physical stock counts and reconcile them against system stock.
* Investigate and report **stock variances, excess consumption, shortages, damages, wastage and slow-moving items**.
* Monitor minimum, maximum and reorder levels to prevent both stock-outs and unnecessary overstocking.
* Coordinate inter-outlet stock transfers and maintain proper documentation for every movement.
* Work with Accounts to ensure invoices, purchase orders, GRNs and vendor statements are correctly reconciled.
* Ensure appropriate documentation and traceability for imported and high-value products.
* Support monthly **food cost and beverage cost closing** by providing accurate purchase, consumption and inventory data.
* Maintain store hygiene, organisation, labelling and food-safety standards.
* Assist management with monthly purchase analysis, vendor comparisons and opportunities for procurement savings.

Qualifications

* **2–5 years of experience** in purchasing, stores or inventory control, preferably within restaurants, hotels or hospitality.
* Strong understanding of **food and beverage purchasing and inventory management**.
* Knowledge of restaurant ingredients, especially meat, seafood, dairy, fresh produce, dry goods and imported products, is preferred.
* Experience with **PO, GRN, stock transfer, stock issue and inventory reconciliation** processes.
* Strong numerical ability and attention to detail.
* Proficiency in **Microsoft Excel**, particularly filters, lookups, pivot tables and inventory/purchase analysis.
* Familiarity with restaurant inventory/POS/ERP systems is preferred.
* Ability to negotiate confidently with vendors while maintaining strong supplier relationships.
* Understanding of **FIFO, FEFO, food safety, storage temperatures and hygiene standards**.
* Ability to identify unusual stock variances, price changes and consumption patterns.
* Diploma or degree in Hospitality, Supply Chain, Commerce or a related discipline preferred.

Key Performance Indicators

Performance will primarily be measured through:

* Purchase-price control and vendor competitiveness
* Product availability and reduction of stock-outs
* Inventory accuracy
* Stock variance and wastage control
* Timely PO/GRN/invoice processing
* Vendor delivery and quality performance
* Adherence to approved product specifications
* Monthly stock-closing accuracy
* Reduction of excess and slow-moving inventory
* Timely management reporting

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

**Sous Chef**

**Holiday Inn Chennai OMR IT Expressway**

**A Little Taste of Your Day-to-Day**

Every day is different, but you’ll mostly be:

**Kitchen Operations**

* Assist the Executive Chef and Executive Sous Chef in managing all daily kitchen operations.
* Supervise food production for restaurants, banquets, events and other F&B requirements.
* Ensure every meal meets the required standards of taste, quality, presentation and consistency.
* Ensure food is prepared and served on time.
* Monitor kitchen activities across all sections.
* Ensure proper mise en place and production planning.
* Coordinate kitchen operations based on occupancy, business levels and events.
* Ensure smooth communication between Kitchen and Food & Beverage teams.
* Take an active, hands-on role during busy operational periods.

**Food Quality & Presentation**

* Ensure all dishes meet IHG brand and hotel quality standards.
* Maintain consistency in taste, portion size and presentation.
* Monitor recipe adherence and portion control.
* Follow and maintain standard recipes.
* Conduct regular food tasting and quality checks.
* Monitor guest feedback relating to food quality.
* Take corrective action wherever required.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve menus and culinary offerings.

**Leadership & Team Development**

* Lead, guide, coach and develop the culinary team.
* Build a motivated, skilled and engaged kitchen team.
* Prepare and manage kitchen duty rosters.
* Allocate colleagues effectively across different sections.
* Conduct daily kitchen briefings.
* Monitor colleague performance and productivity.
* Provide regular coaching and constructive feedback.
* Identify training and development needs.
* Develop multi-skilled colleagues through cross-training.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, discipline and professional conduct.
* Support succession planning and career development.

**Guest Experience**

* Ensure positive responses to guest feedback and special requests.
* Monitor guest comments relating to food quality and dining experiences.
* Coordinate with the F&B team to address guest concerns.
* Support effective service recovery.
* Ensure special dietary requirements and guest preferences are handled appropriately.
* Support VIP, repeat guest and special occasion requirements.
* Ensure food experiences contribute to memorable guest stays.

**Menu Planning & Events**

* Support menu planning and development in coordination with the Executive Chef.
* Work closely with Food & Beverage leadership on events and special occasions.
* Develop menus appropriate to guest profiles and business requirements.
* Support banquet, conference and catering menu planning.
* Ensure appropriate food production plans are prepared for events.
* Review recipes and ingredients for quality and cost effectiveness.
* Introduce new culinary ideas while maintaining operational practicality.

**Food Cost & Budget Management**

* Support the Executive Chef in managing kitchen budgets and financial performance.
* Monitor food cost and departmental expenses.
* Control food wastage and unnecessary consumption.
* Ensure proper portion control and recipe compliance.
* Monitor recipe costing and food cost performance.
* Identify opportunities for cost optimisation without compromising quality.
* Monitor kitchen productivity and labour costs.
* Support forecasting based on occupancy and business levels.

**Purchasing & Inventory**

* Coordinate with Purchasing and Stores for procurement of food products.
* Ensure ingredients meet the required quality standards.
* Maintain appropriate par stock levels.
* Monitor stock movement and consumption.
* Conduct regular inventory checks.
* Ensure proper FIFO/FEFO practices.
* Minimise food wastage, spoilage and pilferage.
* Evaluate product quality and supplier performance.
* Ensure correct receiving, storage and issuing procedures.

**Food Safety & Hygiene**

* Maintain the highest standards of food safety and kitchen hygiene.
* Ensure compliance with applicable food safety regulations and IHG standards.
* Monitor food storage and temperature controls.
* Ensure proper food handling procedures.
* Ensure cleaning and sanitation schedules are followed.
* Maintain personal hygiene and grooming standards.
* Conduct regular kitchen hygiene inspections.
* Ensure appropriate records and checklists are maintained.
* Support food safety audits and inspections.
* Ensure required certifications and permits are maintained.

**Kitchen Equipment & Maintenance**

* Ensure all kitchen equipment is operated safely and efficiently.
* Monitor equipment condition and performance.
* Report maintenance issues to Engineering.
* Follow up on breakdowns and repairs.
* Ensure preventive maintenance is completed.
* Ensure proper cleaning and storage of equipment.
* Support the efficient use of kitchen equipment and resources.

**Sustainability & Responsible Business**

* Promote responsible kitchen practices.
* Reduce food waste and encourage responsible ingredient usage.
* Monitor water and energy consumption.
* Promote recycling and appropriate waste segregation.
* Minimise unnecessary use of disposables.
* Educate the kitchen team on sustainability initiatives.

**Departmental Coordination**

Work closely with:

* **Executive Chef / Executive Sous Chef** – Kitchen operations, food quality, cost control and team development.
* **Food & Beverage** – Service standards, guest feedback, events and outlet requirements.
* **Finance** – Budgets, forecasting, food cost and inventory.
* **Purchasing / Stores** – Procurement, product quality and stock management.
* **Engineering** – Kitchen equipment and maintenance.
* **Housekeeping / Stewarding** – Hygiene, cleanliness and sanitation.
* **Front Office** – VIPs, guest preferences and special occasions.
* **HR** – Recruitment, training, engagement and performance.
* **Security** – Safety and emergency requirements.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Food quality and consistency
* Guest satisfaction
* Food-related guest complaints
* Food cost percentage
* Food wastage
* Kitchen productivity
* Labour cost
* Inventory variance
* Recipe compliance
* Hygiene and food safety scores
* Audit performance
* Menu performance
* Banquet and event execution
* Training completion
* Colleague engagement
* Kitchen equipment uptime

**What We Need From You**

**Education**

* Degree, Diploma or Certificate in Culinary Arts, Hotel Management, Hospitality or a related field.

**Experience**

* Minimum 7 years of culinary/kitchen experience
* At least 2-3 year in a supervisory capacity, or an equivalent combination of education and culinary/kitchen operations experience.
* Experience in a branded or international hotel is preferred.
* Experience handling restaurant, banquet and high-volume food production is an advantage.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong culinary and kitchen operations knowledge.
* Strong leadership and people-management skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good understanding of food cost and budgeting.
* Good menu planning and recipe costing knowledge.
* Strong food safety and hygiene knowledge.
* Excellent attention to detail.
* Creative and innovative approach to food.
* Strong organisational and planning skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Ability to work under pressure.
* Proactive and hands-on approach.
* Strong guest-service orientation.
* Team player with a positive attitude.

**Language & Certifications**

* Fluent English is required.
* Proficiency in Tamil and other local languages is an added advantage.
* Must obtain and maintain applicable food safety, culinary or statutory certifications and permits required by local authorities.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II
jobs.description:
**Job Requirements**  

“We Power the Magic!” That’s our motto at Disney Experiences (DX). Our team creates world-class immersive digital experiences for the Company’s premier vacation brands including Disney’s Parks & Resorts worldwide, Disney Cruise Line, Aulani, a Disney Resort & Spa, and Disney Vacation Club.

We are responsible for the end-to-end digital and physical Guest experience for all technology & digital-led initiatives across the Attractions & Entertainment, Food & Beverage, Resorts & Transportation and Merchandise lines of business as well as other initiatives including MyDisneyExperience and Hey, Disney!

As a Software Engineer, you will be part of an early‑career engineering team that powers the magic behind our theme parks, resorts, cruise vacations, and global retail and consumer experiences. In this intermediate role, you’ll apply and grow your technical skills while building and enhancing software that supports both Guests and Cast Members across Disney’s travel and vacation portfolio.

**Responsibilities:**

You will design, develop, test, and implement software components and applications of moderate complexity, contributing to end‑to‑end solutions that help deliver seamless, magical experiences across Disney’s parks, resorts, cruise line, vacation ownership, and consumer products businesses. [Disney Segment Reference] In this early career, problem‑solver role, you’ll work with moderate guidance, analyze a range of solutions, provide informal support to newer team members, and explain complex technical information clearly—helping ensure Disney’s technology remains innovative, reliable, and guest‑centric.

* Complete component‑level software development and fixes using established and emerging technologies, focusing on scalable, high‑volume systems and client‑facing web applications.
* Participate in developing specifications, designing components, and contributing to architectural discussions for web, services, or platform solutions.
* Write clean, testable code; create and maintain unit and integration tests; perform debugging and issue resolution across lower and production environments.
* Collaborate with other engineers, technical operations, and cross‑functional partners to build tools, automation, and user interfaces that improve efficiency and support new business functionality.
* Develop and maintain server‑side and web service‑based solutions, microservices, and APIs, and build an understanding of front‑end technology stacks to assist with end‑to‑end problem solving.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, automation tooling, and documentation to support reliable delivery and ongoing quality of Disney Experiences technology platforms.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Strong foundation in object‑oriented programming and software engineering principles, including design patterns, coding best practices, and SDLC concepts.
* Experience developing highly scalable, high‑impact software components, web applications, or services using languages such as Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, .NET, or Python.
* Hands‑on experience with web services or APIs (RESTful and/or SOAP) and microservice or event‑driven architectures.
* Working knowledge of relational and/or NoSQL databases (e.g., SQL, MySQL, DynamoDB, MongoDB, MSSQL, document databases).
* Experience with cloud platforms and infrastructure such as AWS or Google Cloud, including services like EC2/Lambda, API Gateway, containers, or similar offerings.
* Familiarity with modern development tools and practices, including git‑based code management, CI/CD pipelines, test‑driven development, and automation tooling.
* Ability to work as an independent worker and effective team member, with strong problem‑solving skills and the capacity to explain complex information to technical and non‑technical partners.
* MinimumReqiuredEducation: Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Electrical or Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field.
YearsOfExperience: minimum 2 years of professional experience in software engineering or closely related development roles.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with AWS services such as Lambda, S3, API Gateway, CloudWatch, Kinesis, DynamoDB, or container orchestration (ECS/EKS).
* Background in building RESTful APIs or microservices using frameworks like Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, or Node.js, and modern UI development with Angular or similar JavaScript frameworks.
* Experience with test automation frameworks (e.g., Selenium or similar) and quality engineering practices across UI, API, and integration layers.
Preferred Education: Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software, Electrical or Electronics Engineering, or a closely related field.

With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations.

Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other.

Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.

**About the Function:**

Supply Chain & Manufacturing is where our brands are made, moved and delivered to the world.

With over half of our people working across more than 100 sites, this is a complex, large-scale operation that brings together production, logistics, engineering and supplier partnerships.

It’s fast-paced and hands-on, with teams working together to ensure quality, efficiency and sustainability at every stage. From sourcing ingredients to getting products into customers’ hands, you’ll play a role in delivering the brands people know and love.

**About the role:**

* Hands on experience and in depth knowledge of quality management systems, developing quality related SOPs/work instruction and its control
* Analyze raw materials, Intermediate (Blends), EOL Finished Goods & monthly report share to RQC
* Sensory evaluation of samples - RW, DMW, BWW, ENA, Blends, Special Spirits, FF, Caramel, Sugar
* Inspect packaging materials received at Units, Market & monthly report share to RQC/SQPM
* Communicate to vendors on non-conformities and issue of CAR to vendor
* Ensure online Quality Control such as line startup/change over from water treatment to final packing
* Coordinate with other departments for all rejection failures at unit
* Performing the calibration of laboratory equipment & maintaining relevant records for the same as per desired frequency
* Adherence to statutory/LMR/FSSAI compliance requirements during production activities
* Performing all SAP transactions related to PM/RM/FG Result recording, MIP creation
* Analyze samples received for customer/consumer complaint and provide a report on findings to the unit head
* Analyze non-conformities using tools and arrive at CAPA desirable
* Full responsible for Quality audits for shop floor activities

* Knowledge of Microsoft Office package

**Best Suited for Someone who** • Excellent coaching, influencing and communication skills • Good Communication and Presentation skills .

**Qualification :** B.Sc/M.Sc. (Chemistry/Microbiology/Food Technology/Biotechnology) or BE/BTech- Food Tech/Chemical Engineering.

**Experience:** 3-5 years of experience in the areas of Quality Assurance and Quality Systems on Food Processing / FMCG –Distillery, Brewery and Beverage Industry.

**What we’re looking for:**

We’re looking for someone with **3+ years of relevant experience** who enjoys operating at the intersection of **talent, people experience and brand**.

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

* Are a strong relationship builder and are comfortable engaging with senior leaders, HR teams, campus stakeholders and external partners.
* Bring a proactive, curious and forward-looking mindset, with an eye for what could make our early careers and employer brand agenda even stronger.
* Can translate ideas into action and manage multiple programmes, stakeholders, timelines and budgets with strong execution discipline.
* Have strong communication and influencing skills and can adapt your style across very different audiences.
* Enjoy creating engaging experiences and are willing to challenge established ways of doing things.
* Are comfortable with ambiguity and enjoy working in a fast-moving environment.
* Are comfortable travelling frequently, particularly during key campus and programme periods.

Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you, so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.  
  
We recognise and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package including:

jobs.title: Sr Executive Quality Assurance
jobs.description:
Why Hershey:

At The Hershey Company, our culture is rooted in purpose and inspired by Milton Hershey’s enduring vision that business should create opportunity for others. Through our commitment to corporate philanthropy, we create positive impact by supporting communities, helping children thrive, and operating as a business for good. This includes our deep and long standing partnership with Milton Hershey School, where we invest in education, workforce readiness, and hands on engagement to help students succeed beyond the classroom. Supported by strategic grantmaking, product donations, cross brand collaboration, and strong employee volunteerism, Hershey offers a place to work where making a difference—locally and globally—is part of how we do business every day.

**About The Hershey Company**
-----------------------------

The Hershey Company (NYSE: HSY) is an industry-leading snacks company known for making more moments of goodness through its iconic brands. With a strong portfolio across chocolate, confectionery, and salty snacks, Hershey delights consumers every day. Our beloved brands include Hershey’s, Reese’s, KitKat®, Dots Pretzels, Lesser Evil, Jolly Rancher, Twizzlers, Ice Breakers, and more.

At Hershey, we are committed to making a meaningful difference in the communities where we live, work, and do business. This commitment originated with our founder, Milton Hershey, and continues to shape who we are today.

Guided by our employee value proposition, **Lead Today. Create Tomorrow,** we empower our people to drive impact now while shaping what comes next. Our **One Hershey** mindset brings teams together across functions, geographies, and businesses, enabling us to operate with speed, collaboration, and shared purpose.

The Hershey Company is proud to be recognized as a top employer in the United States, reflecting our commitment to our people, culture, and purpose.

**How will you fit in the big picture?**
----------------------------------------

The Sr Executive - QRC leads shift-level Quality & Regulatory Compliance activities across aseptic packaging and cocoa/non-cocoa syrup manufacturing. The role ensures effective in-process controls, product quality, food safety and regulatory compliance while managing deviations, consumer complaint investigations, corrective and preventive actions, and continuous improvement initiatives. It also provides technical guidance to QRC and shop-floor teams and collaborates cross-functionally to uphold Hershey Quality and Food Safety standards.

**What will you do?**
---------------------

Lead shift-level quality assurance for aseptic packaging and cocoa/non-cocoa syrup manufacturing, including monitoring critical process and quality parameters.

Ensure in-process controls, product analysis, and timely escalation and disposition of quality deviations.

Identify process and product deviations and collaborate with Production, Engineering, Supply Chain, and other functions on root cause analysis and CAPA.

Conduct food safety, GMP, and hygiene audits and ensure timely closure of observations.

Support HACCP activities and reinforce food safety controls across processing and packaging stages.

jobs.title: AI Operations Engineer
jobs.description:
**Imagine yourself...**

* Doing meaningful work that makes an everyday impact on the world around you.
* Owning your ambition and fueling your career growth.
* Collaborating with a vibrant, diverse, global team.

Headquartered in Broomfield, Colorado, TraceGains, a Veralto company, connects people and information so teams can work smarter. We provide networked innovation, quality, and compliance solutions that help consumer brands reduce supply chain risk, accelerate business processes, and take control of their data.

At TraceGains, we believe “we’re in this together.” Innovation and ingenuity start with a diverse workforce and an inclusive workplace, and we encourage people from all backgrounds to apply.

**Reporting to the Head of AI,** the AI Operations Engineer will deploy, operate, and continuously improve the infrastructure supporting AI applications, agentic systems, and machine learning workloads. This hands-on role combines DevOps, MLOps, and LLMOps to make AI delivery repeatable, secure, observable, reliable, and cost-effective. The role is based in India and contributes to shared DevOps improvements across engineering.

**In this role, a typical day will look like:**

* Build and operate Azure infrastructure, containerized services, networking, storage, model-serving environments, and agentic workflows using infrastructure as code and reusable modules.
* Automate CI/CD pipelines for AI services, models, prompts, and configurations, including testing, evaluation gates, versioning, staged deployment, traceability, and rollback.
* Implement production observability through dashboards, logging, tracing, alerts, service-level objectives, and monitoring of reliability, quality, latency, token usage, and cost.
* Improve operational resilience by troubleshooting failures, managing quotas and rate limits, conducting load and capacity tests, validating backup and recovery procedures, and participating in incident response and root-cause analysis.
* Apply security and governance controls such as identity and access management, secrets handling, least-privilege access, tenant isolation, data-retention controls, sensitive-data protection, and audit logging.
* Provide reproducible development and evaluation environments, maintain operational documentation and runbooks, support retrieval pipelines and agent workflows, and contribute reusable DevOps tooling across engineering.

**The essential requirements of the job include:**

* 3+ years of experience in DevOps, cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, site reliability engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Hands-on experience operating production services on Microsoft Azure and deploying or supporting at least one production AI or machine learning service.
* Strong foundations in Linux, networking, containers, Git-based workflows, infrastructure as code, and CI/CD, with working proficiency in Python and familiarity with shell scripting.
* Practical experience with Terraform or Bicep, GitHub Actions or Azure Pipelines, and production monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, incident troubleshooting, and cloud cost management.
* Understanding of secure deployment practices, including identity and access management, secrets handling, tenant isolation, and sensitive-data protection, plus the ability to work independently and collaborate across AI, engineering, platform, and security teams.

**It would be a plus if you also possess:**

* Experience operating AI-enabled enterprise SaaS products or agentic applications in production, particularly on Azure.
* Experience with Kubernetes or Azure managed container services, model-serving platforms, LLM observability, evaluation pipelines, model registries, experiment tracking, or model and dataset versioning.
* Experience supporting retrieval systems, vector databases, fine-tuning pipelines, GPU workloads, enterprise data governance, or the food, beverage, and supplements industry.

**What success looks like in the first six months:**

* Deliver repeatable releases with tested rollback for assigned services.
* Establish actionable reliability, quality, and cost dashboards.
* Validate runbooks and recovery procedures.
* Deliver at least one reusable DevOps improvement adopted beyond the AI team.

**Why you’ll want to join us:**

TraceGains is a growing software company providing cloud-based new product development and compliance solutions for food, beverage, and dietary supplement companies. Our network platform digitizes documentation, automates workflows, and helps customers share information across their supply chains.

TraceGains is part of Veralto, a global family of companies united by a shared purpose: Safeguarding the World’s Most Vital Resources™. You will work in a collaborative environment where purpose meets possibility and where your work can have an everyday impact.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

TraceGains provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment based on any characteristic protected by applicable law. Employment is subject to applicable work-authorization and background-screening requirements.

At Veralto, we value diversity and the existence of similarities and differences, both visible and not, found in our workforce, workplace and throughout the markets we serve. * **Senior Engineer - Mechanical**

  **Your Role:**

The Senior Director of Packaging leads the Packaging pole of Product Operations: Packaging Development & Industrialization, and a new Packaging R&D capability. This role owns the technical packaging solution from brief to production readiness at suppliers and contract manufacturers, moves technical risk upstream through risk-based pilots and evidence, and builds proven, PPWR-ready platforms for future launches. It works with an independent End-to-End Quality team.
  
  
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
:
  
  
**Packaging Strategy & Leadership**

**Packaging Development & Industrialization**

**Packaging R&D & Innovation**

* Own packaging specifications and drive the adoption of the internal specification tool.
* Never trade an unresolved critical risk for cost or timing; any skipped step goes to the Newness Committee.
* Lead root cause and permanent fixes for design-origin issues; support Quality and the Crisis Cell on supply issues.

**Leadership and Coaching**

* Recruit and grow sub-pole leads; build succession for critical technical roles.
* Act as a role model for technical rigor and evidence-based decisions.

**Cross-Functional Partnership & Strategic Exposure**

* Partner with Product Development, Marketing, Design, Quality, Procurement, Supply Chain, Regulatory, Commercial and Finance.
* Bring feasibility, cost, timing and risk input at the brief, with the pack brief issued alongside the formula brief.
* Represent Packaging at the Newness Committee and in launch readiness reviews.
* Drive value engineering and COGS improvement without trading critical risk; manage the packaging technical budget

**Requirements**

* Proven delivery of complex primary packs from concept through tooling, line trials and scale-up at suppliers and contract manufacturers.
* Deep expertise in materials, processes, GD&T, tolerance stack-ups and formula/pack compatibility.
* Hands-on experience of pilot tooling, homologation and stage-gate governance.
* Experience building a pre-development, R&D or platform program.
* Proven leader of leaders, delegating through clear decision rights.
* Able to read and challenge CAD models and technical drawings.
* Solid understanding of packaging sustainability and the EU PPWR, and their impact on design, cost and supply.
* Experience with global supplier bases in Europe and Asia.
* Track record of evidence-based judgment, comfortable with ambiguity and scale-up dynamics.

* Bachelor's/Master's in Packaging, Mechanical, Materials or Plastics Engineering.

**Benefits**

* Monthly "Self Love Days" - at company discretion
* Premium Medical/Dental/Vision coverage for employee plus dependents
* Monthly coaching sessions with our in-house Success Coach
* Employee discounts on all Huda Beauty products
* Quarterly product gifting

**About Gradiant**

Gradiant is a Different Kind of Water Company. With a full suite of differentiated and proprietary end-to-end solutions for advanced water and wastewater treatment powered by the top minds in water, the company serves its clients’ mission-critical operations in the world’s essential industries, including semiconductors, pharmaceuticals, food & beverage, critical minerals, and renewable energy. Gradiant’s innovative solutions reduce water used and wastewater discharged, reclaim valuable resources, and renew wastewater into freshwater. The Boston-headquartered company was founded at MIT and has over 1,400 employees worldwide. Discover us at www.gradiant.com.

**Job Overview**

* Own and lead the development of Gradiant’s mineral extraction technologies from laboratory concept through pilot validation, scale-up and commercial deployment, covering extraction, purification, concentration and conversion to the final products.
* Set the technical direction across extraction routes (e.g. sorbents/ion exchange, solvent extraction, membranes, precipitation/crystallization), lead the R&D team, and serve as the technical authority for customers, partners and internal project teams.

**Specific Duties/Responsibilities**

*Technology strategy and roadmap*

* Define and own the technology roadmap for mineral extraction, purification and conversion, aligned with business and market needs.
* Benchmark competing technologies, evaluate new chemistries (sorbents, extractants, membranes) and partner technologies, and drive IP generation.

*Lead R&D team and manage projects*

* Lead and mentor the R&D team across SG and AD Labs (scientists, engineers and interns); set priorities and guide experimental design and data analysis.
* Oversee planning, budgets, execution and tracking of projects and procurement; liaise with vendors, contractors and internal groups; prepare key presentations and reports for leadership.

*Process development and flowsheet design*

* Develop and optimize mineral extraction flowsheets for high recovery and selectivity over competing ions (e.g. Na, K, Mg, Ca, B), including impurity control, reagent/solvent management and recycle streams.
* Perform process modelling, mass and energy balances and techno-economic inputs to produce high-purity final product.

*Scale-up and technology transfer*

* Lead the progression from lab and bench scale to pilot and demonstration; design, procure and commission pilot units.
* Resolve scale-up challenges (e.g. phase separation, solvent loss, sorbent lifetime, fouling, impurity build-up, process stability) and prepare process design packages for engineering and project teams.

*Commercialization and customer support*

* Lead end-to-end application studies on real feeds (brines, produced water, leachates) from feasibility through process validation.
* Support proposals, feasibility studies and performance guarantees; provide on-site commissioning, troubleshooting and optimization at customer plants.

*Partnerships and stakeholder engagement*

* Build and manage collaborations with customers, technology providers, universities and suppliers to accelerate technology validation and deployment.
* Represent Gradiant’s mineral extraction technology in technical discussions with customers, partners and at industry forums.

**Qualification, Skills & Experience**

*Qualification*

* Ph.D. in Chemical or Environmental Engineering, Chemistry, Hydrometallurgy, Materials Science or a related discipline.
* Master’s degree with a strong industrial critical-minerals track record will also be considered.

*Skills*

* Deep expertise in at least one mineral extraction route (solvent extraction, ion exchange/adsorption, membranes or precipitation/crystallization), with working knowledge of the others.
* Process modelling and flowsheet design (mass/energy balances; tools such as Aspen, OLI or PHREEQC) and analytical methods (ICP-OES/MS, IC).
* Strong leadership, communication and customer-facing skills; able to translate technical results into business decisions.

*Experience*

* 10+ years in critical-minerals process development, including 3+ years leading technical teams.
* Proven track record taking a technology from lab through pilot to commercial or industrial operation.
* Hands-on experience in plant commissioning, troubleshooting and optimization, and in technology transfer to engineering or customers.
* Experience with industrial water/wastewater treatment and international customers is an advantage.

*Certificate*

* Preferred, not mandatory: Professional Engineer (PE/P.Eng), PMP, Lean Six Sigma or equivalent.

Gradiant is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class.

The Wellness Therapist is responsible for, but not limited to performing as trained all spa treatments, hammam and beauty therapies and services to guests professionally and with personalized service. Developing relationships with local guests and residents creates loyalty and keeps guests coming back regularly to the Spa, this is also a crucial commitment required by the Spa Therapist, as is encouraging home care between appointments and supporting retail sales targets. * Be on time for appointments and thoroughly review appointments after completing each treatment.

* Report any incidents or odd behavior to Spa Management.
* Ensure correct amounts of treatment products are used and wastage is minimized as per resort standards.
* Adhere to all health and safety standards of the spa and of the resort.

* Be flexible in working schedules as per resort requirements.

* Report dysfunctional equipment or issues with the facility to Wellness Director
* To maintain inventory of supplies for the operations of the treatment rooms
* To attend daily line-ups, weekly and monthly spa meetings.
* Will be expected to assist and perform various demonstrations and events.
* To maintain a high standard of appearance and personal hygiene as lay down by the Wellness Director.
* Must attend all training courses as deemed necessary and must adhere to training as set down by the Wellness Director.

* To recognize the importance of recommending other beneficial services and products that would enhance the guest experience or help the guest achieve their desired results in every aspect of their role and be responsible for achieving sales targets as set by the Wellness Director.
* To maintain a friendly, professional demeanor at all times, and be adaptable and accountable for all actions.

**About You**

* Desire to connect with guests in order to personalize service, excellent and open communication style, well spoken, professional demeanor.
* Willingness to learn and absorb new skills whilst honing and perfecting those already achieved.
* Organized, neat & tidy, and can work autonomously or as part of a team
* notices the small details that make or break a guest experience, sensitive to guests non-verbal communication.

We offer a competitive, tax-free salary paid in UAE Dirhams (AED), alongside a wealth of benefits. jobs.title: Head PreClinical- Animal Pharmacology & Toxicology
jobs.description:
VENUS MEDICINE RESEARCH CENTRE (VMRC)

Position: Head – Animal Pharmacology & Toxicology

**Department:**
Preclinical Sciences

**Reports To:**
Chief Scientific Officer

**Location:**
On-site, Full-time

Role Overview

VMRC is advancing a diversified pipeline spanning novel anti-infectives, BL+BLI combinations, and differentiated herbal therapeutics. The Head – Animal Pharmacology & Toxicology will lead all in vivo pharmacology, ADME, toxicology, translational PK–PD, and pharmacometrics activities across the portfolio.

This is a senior scientific leadership role requiring deep expertise in anti-infective development, renal pharmacology, nephrotoxicity assessment, PK–PD modelling, and IND-enabling toxicology, combined with strong regulatory and team leadership capability.

Key Programmes

Renal Guard Programme (Phase 1)

A reformulated polymyxin programme focused on reducing nephrotoxicity while maintaining antimicrobial efficacy.

Key areas:

* Renal injury biomarkers: KIM-1, NGAL, Cystatin C, NAG, Osteopontin
* Renal pharmacology and drug disposition
* Histopathology integration
* Complex PK interpretation in limited-literature settings

Meropenem + MET-X Programme (Late Preclinical)

A BL+BLI combination targeting carbapenem-resistant Gram-negative infections.

Key areas:

* IND-enabling ADME and toxicology
* Translational PK–PD
* Monte Carlo simulation & PTA
* Dose optimisation using:
* fT>MIC
* fAUC/MIC
* Cmax/MIC
* Clinical dose projection and resistance suppression strategy

Qualifications & Experience

* Ph.D. in Pharmacology, Toxicology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Translational Medicine, or related discipline
* 10+ years in preclinical in vivo drug development
* 5+ years leading multidisciplinary preclinical teams
* Experience advancing assets through IND/CTA-enabling development
* Strong expertise in:
* Anti-infectives
* Toxicology
* Renal pharmacology
* PK–PD/pharmacometrics
* GLP laboratory and regulatory submission experience preferred
* Strong publication and scientific presentation record

Key Responsibilities

Scientific Leadership

* Define and execute portfolio-wide in vivo strategy
* Lead pharmacology, toxicology, ADME, and PK–PD functions
* Serve as Study Director/PI for internal and outsourced studies
* Lead team development, budgeting, infrastructure, and resource planning
* Interface with CMC, microbiology, clinical, regulatory, and bioanalytical teams

In Vivo Pharmacology & Infection Models

* Lead rodent and non-rodent infection models:
* Thigh
* Lung
* Sepsis
* Resistance amplification
* Dose-fractionation studies
* Evaluate exposure–response, bacterial burden, survival, and resistance suppression
* Support herbal and metabolic programme evaluation

Renal Pharmacology & Toxicology

* Lead nephrotoxicity strategy for Renal Guard
* Integrate biomarkers, PK, and histopathology
* Interpret renal injury pathways and kidney drug disposition

ADME & Translational PK–PD

* Oversee PK, tissue distribution, ELF/renal penetration, and permeability studies
* Lead NCA, compartmental and population PK analyses
* Conduct PTA and Monte Carlo simulations
* Support dose projection and breakpoint justification

Required tools:

* Phoenix WinNonlin
* NONMEM
* R or equivalent platforms

Toxicology & Safety

* Oversee acute/repeat-dose toxicity, safety pharmacology, TK, and local tolerance studies
* Interpret NOAEL, MTD, therapeutic index, and safety margins
* Ensure alignment with ICH and IND/CTA requirements

Regulatory & GLP

* Lead nonclinical regulatory submissions:
* CTD Modules 2.4, 2.6, 4
* FDA, EMA, CDSCO submissions
* Drive GLP compliance, SOP quality, QA readiness, and facility accreditation
* Support publications, scientific presentations, and regulatory interactions

Regulatory Knowledge (Non-Negotiable)

Strong working knowledge of:

* OECD GLP Principles
* ICH M3(R2), S-series, E6(R2)
* IAEC/CPCSEA guidelines
* IBSC requirements
* ARRIVE & 3Rs principles
* IND/CTA/NDA nonclinical documentation

Ideal Candidate

* Proven anti-infective or antimicrobial development experience
* Exposure to BL+BLI or combination products
* Expertise in nephrotoxicity and renal biomarker science
* Strong translational and regulatory mindset
* Demonstrated ability to build high-performing preclinical teams and infrastructure

**Company:** Northern Solvents Private Limited

**Compensation:** ₹15,000 – ₹25,000 per month

**Location:** Vaishali Nagar, Jaipur, Rajasthan

**Job Type:** Full-time

**About the Company**

Northern Extracts is a manufacturer of oleoresins, essential oils, and herbal extracts, specializing in North Indian herbs and spices. We serve the seasonings, flavors, fragrance, and nutraceutical industries across domestic and international markets.

Our Corporate Office is in Jaipur, with a manufacturing facility in Roopangarh, near Ajmer. The company is committed to quality, food safety, and regulatory compliance, with applications for FSSC 22000, ISO, Kosher, Halal, and FSSAI certifications.

**Role Overview**

To ensure timely procurement, optimum inventory availability, supplier performance, material traceability, and cost-effective purchasing in coordination with Production, Planning, QA/QC, R&D, Stores, Finance, and other functions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Purchase & Procurement:** Procure raw materials, essential oil ingredients, botanical materials, packaging, chemicals, and consumables; obtain quotations; negotiate commercial terms; prepare POs; follow up deliveries; and maintain approved suppliers.
* **Inventory Management:** Maintain optimum stock, minimum/maximum and safety levels; monitor slow/non-moving and excess stock; conduct physical verification; reconcile ERP records; and ensure FIFO/FEFO and batch-wise control.
* **Material Planning:** Coordinate with Production, Planning, QA/QC, R&D, and Stores; review production plans; prepare MRP; ensure critical material availability; and identify shortages in advance.
* **Food-Grade / Essential Oil Control:** Procure against approved specifications; coordinate COA, food-grade, allergen, MSDS/SDS and origin documentation; support incoming inspection; maintain batch/lot traceability and suitable storage conditions.
* **Vendor Management:** Develop alternate suppliers; negotiate annual/long-term rates where practical; monitor TAT (Turn Around Time), rejection, lead time and competitiveness; resolve supplier issues; and conduct vendor performance reviews.
* **Stores & Warehouse Coordination:** Coordinate inward receipt, GRN (Goods Receiving Note), inspection and issue; maintain identification, labeling and location control; support segregation of approved/rejected/under-inspection/expired materials; and coordinate returns/transfers.
* **ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) & Documentation:** Maintain Purchase request, RFQ (Requisition Form), quotation comparison, PO (Purchase Order), GRN (Goods Receiving Note), stock and supplier records; ensure authority-matrix compliance; support audit documentation; and coordinate PO/GRN/invoice matching with Finance.
* **Cost Control:** Identify purchase savings and optimization opportunities; compare historical/market prices; control emergency purchases and excess inventory; and negotiate improved commercial terms without compromising quality or supply continuity.

**Key Competencies**

* Procurement & negotiation
* Inventory planning & stock control
* Vendor management
* MRP / material planning
* ERP-based purchasing
* Food-grade documentation & traceability
* Cross-functional coordination
* Cost optimization
* MIS reporting
* Problem solving

**Skills & Qualifications**

* Experience: Minimum 4–5 years of experience in Purchase/Procurement, preferably in a manufacturing environment.

* Good communication, coordination, follow-up and negotiation skills.
* Strong numerical accuracy and documentation skills.
* Working knowledge of ERP/system-based purchasing and inventory transactions.
* Ability to work in a manufacturing environment and manage time-sensitive material requirements.
* Experience in food, herbal, chemical, pharmaceutical, FMCG or similar manufacturing industries will be an advantage.

**Ideal Candidate**

* Based in Jaipur (local candidates preferred)
* Age: 30 years and above

**Why Join Northern Extracts?**

* Hands-on exposure to Purchase, Stores & Inventory Operations.
* Opportunity to build a career in Procurement, Supply Chain and Manufacturing.
* Cross-functional exposure to various manufacturing and business functions.
* Opportunity to work with experienced professionals and take responsibility.

jobs.description:
The Kamei Reverse Bioengineering Laboratory within the Divisions of Science and Engineering at NYU Abu Dhabi invites applications for a Post-Doctoral Associate position that advances the frontiers of developmental biology and disease modeling. The laboratory integrates stem-cell biology, fluorescence imaging, bioinformatics, and advanced nano- and micro-engineering to decode organogenesis and early embryogenesis, translating these insights into regenerative medicine, drug discovery, and precision therapeutics.
  
  
The appointed fellow will design and fabricate nano- and micro-engineered platforms that interface with human stem cells, investigate cellular and molecular mechanisms governing development and pathology, lead experiments from conception through publication in high-impact journals, mentor graduate and undergraduate researchers, and contribute to grant writing and interdisciplinary collaborations.
  
  
Applicants must hold a Ph.D. in science, engineering, or a closely related field awarded before the start date, and is within the first five years post-receiving a PhD. Competitive candidates will demonstrate expertise in areas such as device design and fabrication, stem-cell culture and differentiation, high-resolution imaging, single-cell or bulk omics, or bioinformatics, together with a strong publication record, excellent communication skills, and a collaborative mindset.
  
  
For consideration, applicants need to submit a cover letter, curriculum vitae with full publication list, statement of research interests, transcript, and three letters of reference, all in PDF format. If you have any questions, please email kk4801@nyu.edu (Ken-ichiro Kamei, laboratory PI).
  
  
**About NYU Abu Dhabi**
https://nyuad.nyu.edu/en/
  
  
NYU Abu Dhabi is the first comprehensive liberal arts and research campus in the Middle East to be operated abroad by a major American research university. Times Higher Education ranks NYU among the top 30 universities in the world, making NYU Abu Dhabi the highest-ranked university in the UAE and MENA region. NYU Abu Dhabi has integrated a highly selective undergraduate curriculum across the disciplines with a world center for advanced research and scholarship. The university enables its students in the sciences, engineering, social sciences, humanities, and arts to succeed in an increasingly interdependent world and advance cooperation and progress on humanity’s shared challenges. NYU Abu Dhabi’s high-achieving students have come from over 120 countries and speak over 100 languages. Together, NYU's campuses in New York, Abu Dhabi, and Shanghai form the backbone of a unique global university, giving faculty and students opportunities to experience varied learning environments and immersion in other cultures at one or more of the numerous study-abroad sites NYU maintains on six continents.
  
  
NYUAD is committed to upholding a culture of non-discrimination, anti-harassment, dignity, and mutual respect; providing equal access and opportunity; and fostering academic excellence in learning, research, and teaching.
  
  
Students are drawn from among the world’s best. They are bright, intellectually passionate, and committed to building a campus environment anchored in mutual respect, understanding, and care. The NYUAD undergraduate student body has garnered an impressive record of scholarships, graduate-school admissions, and other global honors. Graduate education is an area of growth for the University; the current graduate student population of over 100 students is expected to expand in the next decade as doctoral programs are developed.
  
  
**Working for NYUAD**
At NYUAD, we recognize that Abu Dhabi is more than where you work; it’s your home. In order for research staff to thrive, we offer a comprehensive benefits package. This starts with a generous relocation allowance; educational assistance for your dependents; access to health and wellness services; and more. NYUAD is committed to research staff success throughout the academic trajectory, providing support for ambitious and world-class research projects and innovative, interactive teaching approaches. Support for dual-career families is a priority.

jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**About Analog Sports**
Analog Sports is a training app built around Ana, an AI coach you can just talk to. She builds your training plan, reads the data from everything you train with, and explains what it means for your next session. Analog sponsors professional cycling teams, and they train on the same platform.
  
  
**The role**
You make Ana a great coach. Ana’s coaching is built on your judgement: you turn how an expert coach decides into rules, numbers and tests that Ana follows, and you check that she gets it right. You won’t coach athletes one to one. Your athletes are everyone who trains with Ana.
  
  
We’re a flat organisation, and you report directly to the CEO.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Define how Ana coaches: training load, form and fatigue, building toward an event, testing and recovery. You write each one as clear rules with thresholds and worked examples.
* Write up the coaching logic for the features you own: the problem, the rules, what good looks like, and how we’ll test it. Then work with design and engineering until it ships.
* Own the maths: every metric and calculation in the app is correct, explained in plain words, and reviewed regularly.
* Build the tests that tell us whether Ana coaches well: real athlete cases, the answers a good coach would give, and a score on every release.
* Review Ana’s work: plans, workout feedback and daily guidance. You find where she’s wrong and fix it with our product and AI engineers.
* Sign off the coaching side of every new feature, alongside product.
* Be the coaches’ voice in the product: how coaches work with their athletes in the app, from one athlete to a squad of 200.
* Work with the coaching staff of the professional teams we sponsor.

**What You’ll Bring**

* 10+ years as an expert coach in cycling, running or triathlon, with amateurs as well as elite athletes.
* Deep knowledge of training load and performance modelling: CTL, ATL and TSB, ramp rate, critical power and critical speed, power and pace zones, testing protocols, periodisation.
* Real experience working with AI. You’ve used AI assistants and models seriously in your work, not just tried them. You know what they do well, where they go wrong (confident answers that are wrong, following what’s written rather than what’s meant), and how to steer them. No coding needed.
* Clear writing. You can turn a judgement call into a rule someone else, or an AI, can follow, edge cases included.
* Comfort with data. You’d rather check a calculation against the raw file than trust the chart.

**Nice to have**

* Coaching swimming.
* Coaching strength and weightlifting for endurance athletes.
* An MSc or PhD in exercise physiology or sports science.
* Experience with a professional, continental or national team.
* Experience working on a training app or platform.

**By the end of your first three months**

* Ana’s coaching rules for load, form and testing are written down and in her hands.
* A coaching test set runs on every release.
* Dynamic training plans are working for running, swimming and weight training, alongside cycling.
* Every metric in the app has been checked and explained.
* You’ve written up the coaching logic for at least one new feature and seen it into the build.

**Compliance & Audits**

jobs.description:
**Overview**
M42 is a global health champion powered by artificial intelligence (AI), technology and genomics to advance innovation in health for people and the planet. Headquartered in Abu Dhabi, M42 combines its specialized, state-of-the-art facilities with integrated health solutions like genomics and biobanks, and harnesses advanced technologies to deliver precise, preventive and predictive care, to disrupt traditional healthcare models and positively impact lives globally.
  
  
The Senior Bioinformatician will join a large genomics and bioinformatics team supporting the Emirati Genome Program (EGP), a national-scale whole genome sequencing initiative. The role is responsible for leading the development, optimization, and automation of large-scale genomic data processing workflows, ensuring reliable, scalable, and reproducible analysis across diverse sequencing technologies. The position contributes to the advancement of production genomics capabilities through workflow innovation, cloud-based computing solutions, quality control frameworks, and continuous improvement of bioinformatics infrastructure.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, implement, and maintain scalable bioinformatics pipelines and workflows for large-scale genomic data processing.
* Build and optimize automated workflows for sequencing quality control, alignment, variant calling, annotation, and downstream genomic analyses.
* Develop and manage workflow orchestration platforms such as Nextflow and equivalent workflow management systems.
* Improve workflow scalability, reproducibility, monitoring, performance, and reliability across high-volume sequencing datasets.
* Evaluate, benchmark, and integrate new bioinformatics tools, sequencing technologies, and analytical approaches into production environments.
* Troubleshoot workflow failures, performance bottlenecks, data quality issues, and unexpected analytical results.
* Support harmonization of genomic data across sequencing platforms, software versions, pipelines, callers, and data releases.
* Apply best practices in genomic quality control, including assessment of sequencing metrics, sample integrity, contamination, variant quality, batch effects, and cohort release criteria.
* Contribute to cloud-based genomic computing environments, containerization technologies, workload optimization, and reproducible software deployment practices.
* Collaborate with scientists, bioinformaticians, software engineers, platform teams, cloud specialists, and data management teams to deliver technical and scientific objectives.
* Identify opportunities for automation, standardization, and continuous improvement of production genomics workflows and operational processes.
* Ensure compliance with organizational policies, data governance requirements, confidentiality standards, and applicable regulatory frameworks.
* Document workflows, technical processes, and validation activities to support reproducibility and operational excellence.

**Qualifications**

* PhD in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Genomics, Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* Equivalent combination of advanced education and relevant professional experience may be considered.
* Significant experience in production bioinformatics, genomic computing, workflow development, cloud genomics, or related technical fields.
* Demonstrated experience leading large-scale genomics infrastructure, pipeline development, or workflow automation projects.
* Experience working with whole genome sequencing (WGS) datasets and large-scale genomic analysis environments.
* Experience with cloud platforms, workflow orchestration frameworks, and high-performance computing environments is strongly preferred.
* Scientific publications, open-source contributions, or ownership of large-scale genomics systems are advantageous.
* Strong programming skills in Python, shell scripting, or related languages.
* Advanced Linux command-line proficiency.
* Experience with Nextflow or similar workflow orchestration frameworks.
* Knowledge of genomic processing tools such as DRAGEN, Sentieon, GATK, bcftools, samtools, and related technologies.
* Experience with Docker, Singularity/Apptainer, containerized workflows, and reproducible software environments.
* Strong understanding of genomic file formats including FASTQ, BAM/CRAM, VCF, and gVCF.
* Expertise in genomic quality control, variant calling, structural variation analysis, and large-scale genomic data processing.
* Familiarity with Git, software version control, and workflow testing practices.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within multidisciplinary technical and scientific teams.

jobs.title: Packaging Development Manager
jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**
At Huda Beauty, our Vision is to lead in creating a democratized beauty industry where power is given back to people to define, create, and enjoy beauty for themselves! Launched by award-winning beauty powerhouse Huda Kattan in 2013, Huda Beauty is one of the world's fastest growing beauty brands. As a company, we are fueled by purpose and not profit, this allows us to approach things differently so that we can create products, content, and a community like no other. A lot has changed since our launch in 2013, but something that will forever remain at the core of Huda Beauty is our focus on business excellence and our unwavering passion for kindness!
  
  
**Summary:**
The Manager, Packaging Development leads the Packaging Development & Industrialization team of Product Operations. This role owns the technical delivery of every packaging launch, from brief to PPS and production readiness at suppliers and contract manufacturers, so each launch is safe, on time and proven. It applies risk-based pathways, runs pilot-first development for new high-risk packs, and decides on evidence, not on supplier statements.
  
  
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
:
  
  
**Launch Portfolio Delivery**

* Own the technical delivery of the packaging launch portfolio, from brief to PPS.
* Review briefs early and give feasibility, cost, timing and risk input, with the pack brief issued alongside the formula brief.
* Allocate projects across the team based on complexity, risk and capacity.
* Personally lead a selected set of the most complex, high-risk launches.
* Escalate early any risk to launch date, quality or cost, with facts and options.

**Risk-Based Development & Evidence**

* Classify each project at the brief by what is new and its 1 to 5 risk score; propose the pathway (Fast Lane, Targeted, Full Pilot-First) for confirmation by Quality.
* For new, high-risk packs, run pilot molds, functional and compatibility tests and line trials on pilot parts before any production mold.
* Prepare the evidence for the Tech Assessment, Pilot Homologation and GO PROD gates.
* Apply Specifications checkpoints in proportion to risk, with an owner, evidence and sign-off for each.
* Define the test strategy and acceptance criteria with Quality.

**Packaging Engineering**

* Own drawings, critical dimensions, GD&T and tolerance stack-ups.
* Lead functional analysis, DFMA, decoration feasibility and formula/pack/process compatibility.
* Use proven platforms and supplier standards from Packaging R&D wherever they fit.
* Keep approved specifications up to date in Specright.

**Industrialization & CM Readiness**

* Lead tooling strategy and mold validation (T0 to T3) with suppliers.
* Confirm supplier and CM technical capability at the Tech Assessment.
* Organize and attend line trials; secure PPS on the final formula.
* Manage technical changes, deviations and concessions through change control, with Quality.
* Lead root cause and permanent fixes for design-origin issues; support Quality and the Crisis Cell on supply issues.

**Leadership and Coaching**

* Lead, coach and develop packaging engineers and developers.
* Set clear ownership, standards and a regular project review cadence.
* Keep the project portfolio data accurate, as the basis for capacity decisions.
* Feed lessons learned into specifications, design rules and Kaizen priorities.

**Cross-Functional Partnership & Strategic Exposure**

* Partner with Product Development, Marketing, Design, Quality, Procurement, Supply Chain and Regulatory.
* Give technical input on supplier choices; Procurement leads RFQs and negotiation.
* Represent Packaging Development in launch reviews and at the Newness Committee when required.
* Contribute to value engineering and COGS savings without trading critical risk.

**Requirements**

* Proven delivery of primary packs (e.g., mascara, gloss, compacts, closures, pumps) from brief to production at external suppliers and contract manufacturers.
* Strong command of technical drawings, GD&T, tolerance stack-ups and injection molding.
* Hands-on experience of mold validation, line trials, PPS and packaging test methods.
* Solid knowledge of formula/pack compatibility and filling and assembly processes.
* Experience leading or coaching packaging engineers.
* Able to review CAD models (SolidWorks or similar) and run a portfolio in a project tool (Asana or similar).
* Able to travel to suppliers and contract manufacturers in Europe and Asia.
* Track record of structured, evidence-based delivery, staying calm under pressure and comfortable with ambiguity and scale-up dynamics.
* 8+ years in packaging development, with significant beauty, fragrance or luxury experience.
* Bachelor's/Master's in Packaging, Mechanical, Materials or Plastics Engineering.

**Benefits**

* Monthly "Self Love Days" - at company discretion
* Premium Medical/Dental/Vision coverage for employee plus dependents
* Monthly coaching sessions with our in-house Success Coach
* Employee discounts on all Huda Beauty products
* Quarterly product gifting

We hire stellar individuals regardless of their race, color, ancestry, religion, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, medical conditions, disability, or veteran status. If you need reasonable accommodations at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.*
