**Job Description – Strategy and Policy Division, Quality Council of India (Hiring for Policy, Legal, Tech and Marketing roles)**

**About the Team**

Strategy and Policy Division (SPD) of the QCI is a team of young professionals working towards augmenting the capacity of government bodies in policy making and formulating high-level strategies for projects that address national priorities. Our work at SPD entails numerous domains, which includes creation of a national level product label scheme, a flagship initiative of the Government of India. The team functions as a high-impact delivery unit within QCI, combining policy research, regulatory analysis, and project execution in a fast-paced, government-facing environment.

**Role Summary**

Your role will support the end-to-end operationalisation of various policies & schemes that QCI designs & implements. The support largely involves regulatory research, creating systems, SOP drafting to stakeholder coordination with regulators and industry associations. Depending on the experience, you would be designated as an Analyst, Associate Manager, or Project Manager (see Section 6). This role blends regulatory and standards domain knowledge with policy research, and scheme-level project management.

**Why This Role Is a Unique Opportunity**

This is not a typical corporate or consulting role. You will be at the centre of building India’s branding framework from the ground up – a programme with direct implications for achieving the goals of Atmanirbhar and Viksit Bharat. The work you do here will shape real policy outcomes.

We are looking for individuals who want to point to a national programme and say, “I helped build that.” If you have domain knowledge in manufacturing, standards, or trade policy, combined with intellectual rigour and a commitment to public service, this is the place for you.

**Key Responsibilities**

**There are 4 different roles (listed from A to D below) for which we are hiring multiple candidates-**

**A. Strategy & Policy**

* **Research & Synthesis:**
  Research BIS, FSSAI and international standards, testing procedures, QCOs, DGFT import-export regulations, HSN codes, rules of origin, NTBs and SPS rules, and turn findings into concise briefs and policy notes for QCI, DPIIT and other stakeholders.
* **Data Analysis & Reporting:**
  Analyse sector-level manufacturing and trade data (production, import penetration, localisation, HS-code trade flows) for sector selection, threshold-setting and impact assessment, and present it through dashboards, leadership and ministerial decks, and research, benchmarking and progress reports.
* **Drafting & Documentation:**
  Draft Scheme Guidelines, SOPs, FAQs, proposal notes, inter-ministerial correspondence and approval documents in government format.
* **Stakeholder & Project Coordination:**
  Coordinate with BIS, BEE, DGFT, Department of Commerce, CII, FICCI, ASSOCHAM and Sector Council members; prepare agendas, minutes and trackers; and track scheme milestones (portal, sector onboarding, Sector Councils) with ministries and QCI leadership.

**B. Legal**

* **Legal Vetting & Drafting:**
  Draft and vet Scheme Guidelines, SOPs, Sector Addenda, undertakings, certificate holder terms, portal terms and privacy notices, MoUs and vendor contracts; prepare legal notes, opinions and file notings; and flag legal risk before any document is issued.
* **Enforcement, Disputes & Litigation:**
  Draft show-cause notices, suspension and cancellation orders, and grievance and appeal decisions in line with natural justice and SOP timelines. Manage challenges from notice to outcome: keep the court and limitation calendar, brief counsel, review pleadings, attend hearings, advise on appeals, and coordinate with the nodal Department where the Union of India is a party.
* **Law Firm & Panel Management:**
  Empanel law firms and counsel; allocate matters, fix scope and fees in work orders and check invoices; and hold firms to QCI’s standards on availability, forum coverage (Supreme Court to district courts, tribunals and consumer fora), conflicts and reporting.
* **IP & Brand Protection:**
  Protect the scheme’s name, logo and QR mark in India and abroad: trademark and certification mark filings, licence terms, register watch, oppositions, online takedowns, cease and desist notices and infringement actions.
* **Regulatory & Trade Law Research:**
  Interpret the BIS Act and QCOs, FSSAI, Legal Metrology, Foreign Trade Policy, customs and rules of origin, WTO and FTA obligations, trademark and GI law, the Consumer Protection Act and CCPA guidelines, and the DPDP and RTI Acts, and brief leadership at QCI and DPIIT.
* **Coordination, Records & Reporting:**
  Coordinate with DPIIT, BIS, DGFT, CCPA, law officers and industry bodies; maintain the Matter Register and precedent bank and feed lessons into SOPs; safeguard manufacturer data (including BOM and cost data); handle RTI and grievance responses; and report on open matters, risk and legal spend.

**C. Technology (Scheme Portal)**

* **Requirements, Design & Product Ownership:**
  Translate the Scheme Guidelines and SOPs into requirements, process flows, user stories and acceptance criteria for each portal module; own the backlog and release roadmap; and review the vendor’s UI/UX, architecture, data models and integrations so the portal is simple for MSMEs, bilingual, mobile-responsive and accessible.
* **Vendor & Delivery Management:**
  Support the RFP and bid evaluation; govern the vendor against plan, milestones and SLAs; assess change requests for scope, effort and cost; and verify deliverables before milestone payments.
* **Testing, Security & Go-Live:**
  Run UAT, triage defects and sign off releases; oversee go-live, data migration and rollback; and ensure CERT-In empanelled audits, compliance with GIGW, the DPDP Act, 2023 and hosting norms, and sound backups, disaster recovery, access control and audit trails.
* **Operations, Support & Reporting:**
  Monitor uptime, helpdesk and incidents against SLAs; secure documentation and knowledge transfer to avoid vendor lock-in; coordinate manuals and training; and define MIS dashboards for QCI and DPIIT.

**D. Marketing & IEC**

* **Marketing Strategy, Research & Campaign Planning:**
  Support the development of marketing and IEC strategies, campaign plans, audience segmentation, communication objectives and key messages, informed by market, audience and communication research and stakeholder feedback.
* **Brand Communication & Content Development:**
  Develop and coordinate clear, consistent communication materials such as brochures, presentations, FAQs, reports, infographics, videos, digital creatives and campaign content.
* **Digital Marketing, Monitoring & Reporting:**
  Coordinate digital outreach, social media content calendars, channel dissemination and audience engagement; track outreach coverage, participation, digital reach and engagement; and use these insights to refine communication and prepare periodic reports and recommendations.
* **Outreach, Events & Stakeholder Engagement:**
  Support awareness campaigns, workshops, conferences, trade fairs and outreach activities; coordinate with internal teams, industry bodies, partners and other stakeholders.
* **Agency & Vendor Coordination:**
  Coordinate briefs, deliverables, timelines and quality reviews with marketing, creative, media, event and IEC agencies or vendors.

**Required Capabilities**

Rapidly interpret standards, QCOs, BEE schedules, DGFT notifications and tariff schedules, using AI tools for faster research and drafting.

Genuine interest in India’s manufacturing, trade and standards ecosystem and its policy developments.

Director; working closely with Production, R&D, Purchase, Stores, Engineering, Fulfilment and Finance

**Role Purpose**

To lead and take overall responsibility for Quality Assurance, Food Safety and Quality Management Systems at CC Pet Foods, ensuring that all manufactured products consistently meet defined quality, nutritional, safety, regulatory and customer requirements.

He/ she will establish and drive a preventive, process-oriented quality culture across raw material sourcing, manufacturing, packaging, storage and dispatch.

The role is accountable for developing robust quality systems, managing the QA team, ensuring regulatory compliance, preventing product failures and driving the company's First Time Right and Zero Compromise on Food Safety philosophy.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Quality Management Systems & Regulatory Compliance**

* Own, implement and continuously improve the factory-wide Quality Management System (QMS).
* Develop and enforce SOPs, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), Good Hygiene Practices (GHP), HACCP plans and food safety controls.
* Lead implementation, certification and maintenance of ISO 22000 / FSSC 22000 or equivalent food safety management systems.
* Ensure compliance with applicable Indian regulatory requirements, relevant BIS standards, customer specifications and internal quality policies.
* Establish quality policies, inspection standards, testing protocols and acceptance criteria across manufacturing operations.
* Lead internal, external, customer and certification audits, ensuring timely closure of non-conformities.
* Maintain complete, accurate and audit-ready quality documentation.

**2. Raw Material & Supplier Quality Management**

* Establish quality specifications and acceptance standards for meat, poultry, fish, organs, vegetables, grains, flours, oils, supplements, additives and packaging materials.
* Own incoming material inspection, testing, acceptance, rejection and quarantine procedures.
* Ensure compliance with approved specifications, Certificates of Analysis (COA), temperature requirements and other quality parameters.
* Lead supplier quality qualification, evaluation, audits and performance improvement initiatives.
* Coordinate with Purchase and Stores to address supplier quality issues and establish corrective actions.
* Ensure material traceability, proper storage conditions and FIFO/FEFO compliance.
* Develop risk-based inspection and sampling plans for critical raw materials.

**3. Manufacturing Process Quality Assurance**

* Own in-process quality assurance across wet food, baked products and dehydrated treats manufacturing.
* Establish and monitor critical quality parameters and process controls across weighing, mixing, cooking, baking, dehydration, cooling, filling and packaging.
* Ensure manufacturing compliance with approved formulations, process specifications and batch records.
* Monitor and validate critical process parameters including time, temperature, moisture, water activity, product weight and packaging integrity.
* Establish preventive controls against cross-contamination, foreign-body contamination and process deviations.
* Lead investigations into manufacturing non-conformities and implement sustainable corrective actions.
* Work with Production and Engineering to improve process capability, reduce rejection and achieve First Time Right production.

**4. Food Safety, Hygiene & Sanitation**

* Take overall responsibility for factory hygiene, sanitation and food safety standards.
* Establish and monitor personnel hygiene, cleaning, sanitation and environmental monitoring programmes.
* Ensure effective hygiene zoning and segregation of raw, semi-processed and finished products.
* Oversee cleaning verification, ATP testing, environmental swabbing and microbiological monitoring.
* Monitor pest control, waste handling, water quality and other environmental conditions affecting food safety.
* Lead food safety risk assessments and ensure timely mitigation of identified hazards.
* Conduct periodic GMP and hygiene audits across production, storage and utility areas.

**5. Finished Product Quality & Batch Release**

* Own finished product quality standards and release procedures.
* Ensure appropriate physical, chemical, microbiological and sensory testing before product release.
* Establish product specifications for nutritional composition, moisture, water activity, packaging integrity, net weight, appearance and shelf life.
* Review batch manufacturing records, process deviations and quality testing results.
* Exercise authority to approve, hold, reject or release finished product batches based on defined quality and food safety criteria.
* Ensure effective management of non-conforming products, retention samples and product stability studies.
* Oversee packaging quality, seal integrity, batch coding, labelling and traceability compliance.

6. Laboratory & Quality Testing Management

* Manage internal quality laboratories and coordinate testing with approved external laboratories.
* Establish testing plans for raw materials, in-process samples, environmental samples and finished products.
* Oversee microbiological, chemical, physical and nutritional quality testing.
* Ensure laboratory equipment calibration, maintenance, method verification and testing accuracy.
* Review laboratory reports, investigate out-of-specification results and approve corrective actions.
* Establish laboratory testing budgets, consumable requirements and equipment procurement plans.
* Work closely with R&D on formulation validation, shelf-life studies and new product development.

**7. Quality Documentation, Traceability & CAPA**

* Establish and maintain robust documentation and record-control systems.
* Ensure end-to-end batch traceability from raw material receipt through manufacturing and dispatch.
* Lead investigations into customer complaints, product defects, contamination risks and quality failures.
* Conduct root cause analysis and ensure effective corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
* Establish product withdrawal and recall procedures and conduct periodic mock recall exercises.
* Maintain quality dashboards, deviation records, audit findings and management review reports.
* Ensure all quality records are complete, accurate and readily available for audits.

**8. Continuous Improvement & Quality Performance**

* Define, monitor and report quality KPIs to senior management.
* Lead initiatives to reduce rejection, rework, process losses, customer complaints and cost of poor quality.
* Identify recurring process deviations and implement preventive improvements.
* Participate in equipment commissioning, process validation, new product trials and manufacturing scale-up.
* Collaborate with Production, R&D, Engineering and Procurement to improve product consistency and manufacturing efficiency.
* Promote data-driven quality decisions and continuous improvement across departments.

**9. QA Team Leadership & Department Management**

* Lead, mentor and develop the Quality Assurance and Quality Control teams.
* Define department structure, responsibilities, manpower requirements and shift coverage.
* Set performance objectives, review team performance and develop technical capabilities.
* Establish training programmes covering GMP, HACCP, hygiene, quality inspection, documentation and food safety.
* Manage the QA department budget, laboratory expenses and quality-related resources.
* Build a culture of accountability, integrity, disciplined execution and continuous improvement.
* Ensure independent and objective quality decisions, including escalation of critical food safety risks to management.

**Company Description**

Syngenta Bioscience Private Limited (SBPL) is one of Syngenta's three global Research & Technology centers, our Goa facility stands at the forefront of agricultural innovation. Our world-class team specializes in developing novel active ingredients, pioneering sustainable synthesis routes and advancing cutting-edge chemical technologies. We have diverse scientific talent pool, with deep expertise in organic chemistry, drives solutions that enhance global food security and sustainable agriculture. At SBPL Goa, we combine scientific excellence with meaningful career growth opportunities, contributing directly to Syngenta's mission of feeding a growing world sustainably.

 **Job Description**

**Role Purpose**

Lead the Analytical team of 5 to 6 scientists in delivering reliable, timely and compliant analytical support to Product Chemistry, Formulation Development, Technology & Sourcing, Manufacturing and Quality. The role requires strong technical expertise, structured problem solving, people leadership, and effective communication with internal and external stakeholders.

**Key Accountabilities**

**Technical and Operational Excellence**

* Lead analytical testing, method development, validation, transfer, verification and troubleshooting activities for active ingredients, intermediates, formulations and relevant raw materials.
* Ensure methods, instruments, laboratory systems and data meet applicable Quality, Health Safety and Environment (HSE), Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) and data-integrity requirements.
* Provide expert scientific judgement for complex deviations, out-of-specification results, investigations, root-cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions.
* Drive laboratory efficiency, robustness and continuous improvement through fit-for-purpose technologies, standardization, automation and lean ways of working.
* Ensure high-quality technical reports, analytical documentation and defensible scientific data to support product, process and regulatory decisions.
* Manage laboratory resources, priorities, capacity, equipment readiness and budget to meet agreed service levels.

**People Leadership**

* Build a capable, engaged and inclusive Analytical team through clear objectives, regular feedback, coaching and performance management.
* Develop technical capability, succession pipelines and individual development plans using structured learning, peer learning and on-the-job experience.
* Promote a culture of scientific curiosity, ownership, collaboration, safety, quality and continuous improvement.
* Recruit, retain and develop talent; ensure appropriate competency assessment and training for laboratory roles.
* Lead by example in applying Syngenta behaviours and creating a respectful, diverse and rightful working environment. The internal people-management framework highlights talent development, coaching and inclusive leadership as core expectations.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Partner closely with Product Chemistry, Process Technology, Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory, Supply, HSE and external laboratories/suppliers.
* Translate business and technical needs into clear analytical strategies, plans, priorities and realistic delivery commitments.
* Communicate complex analytical findings clearly and influence decisions at project, site and regional levels.
* Manage stakeholder expectations proactively, escalating risks, resource constraints and technical issues early with practical options for resolution.
* Represent Analytical in cross-functional project teams, audits, technical reviews and customer/regulatory interactions where required.

jobs.title: Certification Executive
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**   
The Certification Executive – Organic Compliance will be responsible for managing end-to-end organic certification activities across the manufacturing and processing facility. The role includes ensuring complete compliance with **NPOP, USDA NOP, EU Organic Regulations**, and other applicable standards from **raw material inward to finished goods dispatch**, including APEDA TraceNet operations, Transaction Certificate (TC) management, batch traceability, production compliance, documentation, and certification audits.

**Educational Qualification**

* B.Sc. Agriculture / M.Sc. Agriculture
* B.Tech Food Technology / M.Sc. Food Science
* Biotechnology / Microbiology
* Quality Assurance or equivalent qualification
* Additional certification in Organic Standards, HACCP, ISO 22000, Food Safety, or Internal Auditor will be an added advantage.

**Experience**

* 4–5 years of relevant experience in organic food processing, certification, and regulatory compliance.
* Experience in certified organic food manufacturing or processing units is mandatory.
* Experience in export-oriented food manufacturing will be preferred.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Organic Certification Management**

* Ensure compliance with NPOP, USDA NOP, EU Organic Regulations, and customer-specific organic requirements.
* Coordinate with certification agencies for inspections, surveillance audits, renewals, and certification updates.
* Maintain certification validity and statutory compliance.

**2. Raw Material (Inward) Compliance**

* Verify supplier Organic Scope Certificates and Transaction Certificates (TCs).
* Ensure only approved certified organic raw materials are received.
* Verify inward documentation, lot details, and traceability records.
* Coordinate with Procurement and Stores for compliant inward operations.

**3. Production & Processing Compliance**

* Monitor manufacturing activities as per organic certification requirements.
* Create and maintain production batches in ERP and traceability systems.
* Verify Batch Manufacturing Records (BMR) and Batch Packing Records (BPR).
* Monitor material consumption, production yields, wastage, and reconciliation.
* Ensure segregation of organic, in-conversion, and conventional materials.
* Verify cleaning and changeover records before production.

**4. Batch Creation & Traceability**

* Create production batches with complete lot traceability.
* Maintain batch-wise inward, production, processing, and packing records.
* Ensure complete forward and backward traceability.
* Conduct mass balance verification and stock reconciliation.

**5. Finished Goods Compliance**

* Verify finished product labeling as per organic regulations.
* Ensure packaging materials comply with certification requirements.
* Approve finished goods for dispatch after compliance verification.
* Maintain finished goods inventory records.

**6. Transaction Certificate (TC) Management**

* Generate inward and outward Transaction Certificates.
* Manage APEDA TraceNet transactions.
* Coordinate with certification bodies for TC issuance.
* Ensure timely documentation for domestic and export consignments.

**7. Documentation & Record Management**

* Maintain certification documents and statutory records.
* Manage:
* Batch Manufacturing Records (BMR)
* Batch Packing Records (BPR)
* Stock Registers
* Processing Records
* Yield Reports
* Traceability Records
* Cleaning & Sanitation Records
* Dispatch Documentation
* Maintain electronic and physical documentation as per document control procedures.

**8. Audit & Compliance Management**

* Coordinate internal, customer, and certification audits.
* Prepare audit documentation.
* Address non-conformities and implement CAPA.
* Conduct internal compliance inspections.
* Ensure continuous audit readiness.

**9. Warehouse & Inventory Compliance**

* Ensure proper segregation and identification of organic inventory.
* Verify warehouse compliance with certification requirements.
* Conduct stock verification and inventory reconciliation.
* Monitor storage conditions and product integrity.

**10. Cross Functional Coordination**

Coordinate closely with:

* Procurement
* Production
* Quality Assurance
* Warehouse
* Sales & Exports
* Dispatch & Logistics
* Regulatory Affairs

Support new product approvals, certification requirements, employee training, and customer audits.

**Required Knowledge**

* NPOP Organic Standards
* USDA NOP Organic Regulations
* EU Organic Regulations
* APEDA TraceNet
* Transaction Certificate (TC) Management
* Organic Traceability Systems
* ERP Batch Management
* HACCP
* GMP & GHP
* ISO 22000
* FSSAI Regulations
* Food Safety Management Systems
* Documentation Control
* Internal Audit Procedures

**Technical Skills**

* APEDA TraceNet
* ERP (SAP / ERPNext / Oracle / Microsoft Dynamics / Tally ERP or equivalent)
* Microsoft Excel (Advanced)
* MS Word
* PowerPoint
* Inventory Management Systems
* Documentation Management
* Mass Balance & Traceability

**Key Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of organic certification systems.
* Excellent documentation and record management skills.
* High attention to detail.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving ability.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to manage certification audits independently.
* Team coordination and leadership.
* Planning and organizational skills.
* Time management and deadline orientation.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹33,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Because transformation, at its best, is human. We are on a strong path of growth, and you’ll get to be part of that journey — helping shape the systems, culture, and capabilities that will scale with us. **Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Food & Beverage Industry Subject Matter Expert (SME) with 15+ years of industry experience and strong domain expertise in Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), product specification management, packaging development and regulatory compliance.

The ideal candidate should have a deep understanding of end-to-end F&B product lifecycle processes, including product development, formulation, ingredient management, raw material specifications, packaging specifications, finished goods, quality management and product commercialization.

The candidate will play a critical role in providing functional and domain expertise for PLM transformation initiatives, helping translate business requirements into scalable digital solutions. The role will involve working closely with business stakeholders, product development teams, R&D, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Packaging, Manufacturing and IT teams.

A sound understanding of global food regulatory frameworks, particularly EU and USA regulations, is essential.

**Key Responsibilities**

PLM & Product Lifecycle Management

  

* Provide subject matter expertise across the end-to-end product lifecycle, from ideation and product development to commercialization and product maintenance.
* Understand and define PLM processes covering product development, formulation, ingredient management, product specifications, quality and change management.
* Drive standardization of PLM processes, workflows, approval mechanisms and governance across business functions.
* Define business requirements and translate them into functional specifications for PLM platform implementation.
* Support PLM transformation initiatives, process optimization and digitalization programmes.

Product Specification Management

  

* Demonstrate strong expertise in managing product specifications across raw materials, ingredients, intermediates, finished goods and packaging materials.
* Understand specification attributes, technical data, nutritional information, allergen declarations, composition, physical and chemical properties and quality parameters.
* Define and manage specification lifecycle processes, including creation, review, approval, version control and obsolescence.
* Understand specification relationships, hierarchies, inheritance, dependencies and cross functional data requirements.
* Establish governance for specification accuracy, completeness, traceability and data integrity.

Packaging Management

  

* Provide functional expertise in primary, secondary and tertiary packaging processes and specifications.
* Understand packaging materials, structures, dimensions, weights, artwork, labeling, packaging components and material compliance.
* Support packaging development, packaging change management, supplier collaboration and packaging approval processes.
* Understand packaging sustainability, recyclability, material composition and environmental compliance requirements.
* Work with packaging engineering, procurement, quality and regulatory teams to define packaging specifications and associated workflows.

Global Regulatory & Compliance Requirements

  

* Possess a sound understanding of food safety, product labeling, ingredient declarations, packaging compliance and regulatory requirements across global markets.
* Understand supplier declarations, Certificates of Analysis (CoA), Certificates of Compliance (CoC), Statements of Composition and Declarations of Conformity (DoC).
* Work with regulatory teams to ensure product and packaging specifications capture relevant compliance attributes and documentation.
* Familiarity with EU regulatory frameworks, including:

* EU Regulation 178/2002 – General Food Law.
* EU Regulation 1169/2011 – Food Information to Consumers.
* EU Regulation 1935/2004 – Food Contact Materials.
* EU Regulation 10/2011 – Plastic Materials Intended to Come into Contact with Food.
* EU Regulation 2025/40 – Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR).
* REACH and applicable chemical substance compliance requirements.
* Familiarity with USA regulatory frameworks, including:

* FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA).
* FDA 21 CFR requirements applicable to food and food packaging.
* Food allergen labelling requirements under FALCPA and FASTER Act.
* FDA food contact substance requirements.
* Nutrition Facts and ingredient declaration requirements.
* Applicable food packaging and labelling compliance requirements.

Business Process & Stakeholder Management

* Engage with R&D, Product Development, Packaging, Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing, Procurement and Supply Chain stakeholders.
* Conduct business workshops, discovery sessions, process assessments and fit-gap analysis.
* Document AS-IS and TO-BE business processes, functional requirements and process flows.
* Define business rules, approval workflows, roles and responsibilities.
* Support solution demonstrations, functional validation, UAT and business acceptance.
* Act as the domain bridge between business stakeholders and technology implementation teams.

PLM Platform Implementation & Transformation

  

* Provide functional leadership during PLM platform implementation and transformation programmes.
* Support configuration of product, ingredient, specification, packaging and regulatory management capabilities.
* Define functional requirements for data migration, integrations and reporting.
* Support product data governance, master data management and specification harmonization.
* Participate in solution design reviews, sprint planning, testing, defect resolution and deployment.
* Support user training, change management and post-implementation stabilization.

**Key Deliverables**

  

* Business process assessment and AS-IS / TO-BE documentation.
* Functional requirements and PLM solution design inputs.
* Product, ingredient, raw material and finished goods specification models.
* Packaging specification and lifecycle management processes.
* Regulatory and compliance requirement mapping for EU and USA markets.
* Functional workflows, approval processes and change management definitions.

**Job Summary**
This role focuses on delivering high quality support and analysis for healthcare products within commercial claims operations in a day shift office environment. The specialist will apply domain expertise to interpret claims resolve issues and improve processing efficiency while ensuring compliance with company standards and regulatory expectations. Contributions will strengthen organizational performance and promote better outcomes across the healthcare ecosystem.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Analyze commercial healthcare claims data in detail to ensure accurate adjudication and compliance with internal policies and industry regulations driving reliable claim outcomes and operational integrity.
* Collaborate with cross functional teams to clarify claim requirements product rules and benefit structures helping to minimize processing errors and improve end user satisfaction.
* Review complex healthcare product configurations related to commercial claims identifying gaps or inconsistencies and recommending adjustments that enhance claim accuracy and turnaround times.
* Coordinate with operations and quality teams to investigate claim discrepancies document root causes and support remediation activities that reduce rework and improve service levels.
* Utilize claim processing tools and internal platforms to validate eligibility coverage and pricing logic for healthcare products contributing to transparent and fair claim decisions.
* Support process improvement initiatives by tracking key metrics for commercial claims proposing practical changes that improve efficiency reduce manual effort and support sustainable growth.
* Communicate clearly with internal stakeholders using English read write and speak capabilities to explain claim outcomes product rules and process changes in an accessible and professional manner.
* Maintain thorough documentation of claim analysis activities decisions and exceptions ensuring that records support audit readiness and consistent application of healthcare product guidelines.
* Engage in knowledge sharing sessions with peers to exchange insights on commercial claims scenarios emerging product features and best practices that strengthen team capability.
* Monitor day to day claim queues in the office environment prioritize work based on service commitments and ensure timely resolution of cases without requiring travel.
* Apply sound judgment to escalate complex claim issues involving healthcare products enabling quick resolution by specialized teams and protecting member and client interests.
* Support compliance with organizational standards by following established procedures validating data integrity and raising risks or anomalies that could impact claim reliability or regulatory adherence.
* Contribute to broader organizational and societal impact by helping ensure that commercial healthcare claims are processed accurately supporting fair access to healthcare services and reinforcing trust in the healthcare system.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrate solid experience in healthcare products with practical exposure to product rules benefit structures and claim processing flows within commercial environments.
* Possess mandatory domain experience in commercial claims with hands on involvement in evaluating claim eligibility coverage determination and payment decisions.
* Bring between two and four years of professional experience in healthcare claims or related operations showing consistent performance and growing subject matter expertise.
* Use strong English read write and speak skills to articulate complex claim and product information clearly to colleagues and stakeholders across business functions.
* Show proficiency in using claim processing platforms and basic analytical tools to interpret data identify patterns and support continuous improvement of claims workflows.
* Exhibit attention to detail and structured thinking while reviewing claims enabling accurate decisions that support company objectives and positive outcomes for members and providers.

**Certifications Required**
Certified Professional Coder CPC or equivalent healthcare claims certification preferred but not mandatory.

jobs.description:
**About Amperos**
Amperos is healthcare's first AI-native denial management and revenue recovery platform. Our agentic AI works claims end-to-end, from portal follow-ups and payor calls to appeals and medical records, so providers can resolve more denials, recover more revenue, and focus on what matters most: serving patients.
  
  
We just closed a $16M Series A led by Bessemer Venture Partners, with continued participation from Uncork Capital and Neo. We're still small, still early, and going after a $260B+ problem that's only getting worse. If you want to work on hard problems that matter, alongside people who care deeply about the mission (and each other), we'd love to meet you.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a detail-oriented Payment Posting Specialist with 2+ years of experience in RCM to join our team. You'll work at the intersection of traditional claim submission or payment posting workflows and cutting-edge AI, helping our customers submit claims accurately and efficiently while ensuring our automation systems perform at the highest standard.
  
  
You'll be responsible for entering charges, verifying claim accuracy, managing charge submissions to insurance companies, and tracking claims through posting and adjudication. As our product and customer base evolve, your responsibilities may shift to align with near-term priorities—this is a role with meaningful ownership and room to grow.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Payment Posting:**

* Post payments, adjustments, and denials from ERAs, EOBs, and lockbox files into customer PM systems and Amperos platforms
* Balance daily batches, reconcile to bank deposits, and resolve missing or mismatched ERAs
* Flag underpayments and denials
* Resolve unapplied cash, credit balances, refunds, and recoupments, and transfer balances

**What We're Looking For**

* At least 2 years of experience in medical billing, charge entry, or coding verification
* Strong working knowledge of medical coding
* Experience with leading PM systems, including eCW, ModMed, Athenahealth, and more
* Solid understanding of insurance claim submission requirements and pre-authorization processes
* Ability to identify coding errors and clinical editing issues before claim submission
* Detail-oriented, organized, and reliable in documentation and follow-through
* Ability to work US hours (9am–6pm ET) to collaborate with our team and customers
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where processes and priorities can change

Perks & Benefits
  
  

* Competitive compensation with eligibility for a bonus on anniversary date
* Paid sick days and vacation days
* Meal stipends
* Opportunity to grow with a rapidly scaling company and be an early member of a global billing team, as we expand our billing team in India

Our Hiring Promise: A safe, transparent process
  
  
Amperos will never as you for money at any point in the hiring process. That includes application fees, payment for equipment or training, or a fee to move your application forward. No one at Amperos, or anyone acting on our behalf, is authorized to request payment from a candidate.
  
  
**Our Values**

* Lead with Empathy - Great products and teams are built on empathy—whether for our customers, users, or team members. We take the time to walk in others' shoes, listen actively, and truly understand their challenges, needs, and perspectives.
* Humbly Ambitious - We combine humility with ambition. No task is beneath us, and no challenge too big. Greatness comes from being willing to do whatever it takes, while having the courage to take bold risks and learn from failures.
* Radical Agency - Own your domain. Drive initiatives with autonomy and accountability. Think deeply, communicate with the team, and maintain a bias for action.

*Amperos never asks candidates for money at any stage of the hiring process, including fees for interviews, processing, or recruitment. No one at Amperos, or acting on our behalf, is authorized to request payment. If you are asked for payment, please do not send any money and report it confidentially here:*
*Report a Hiring Concern*

jobs.title: Medical Records Analyst
jobs.description:
**About the role**

We are looking for a
**Medical records & billing analyst**
with practical experience reading and interpreting medical documentation and billing records from the United States and/or Germany.

Healthcare billing remains surprisingly manual. A single patient case can generate hundreds of pages of documentation from hospitals, clinics, specialists, laboratories, imaging providers and other healthcare organizations. Much of this information still arrives as PDFs, scans, faxes or paper documents rather than through clean, structured data interfaces.

Large billing operations may employ hundreds of people to manually review these documents, identify the relevant medical and financial information, classify it and transform it into structured billing data.

We believe this workflow is particularly well suited to
**AI-assisted automation**
, but building reliable automation requires people who understand what the documents actually mean.

This role sits at the intersection of
**medical documentation, billing operations, data quality and AI**
.

**What you would do**

You will work with medical records and billing documentation from healthcare providers in the
**United States and Germany**
, including hospitals, clinics, physicians and specialists.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Review large medical records, including cases containing hundreds of pages of clinical and billing documentation.
* Read and interpret hospital bills, physician bills, treatment records, discharge documentation, diagnostic reports and related medical documentation.
* Identify treatments, procedures, diagnoses, services, providers, dates, charges and other relevant information contained across multiple documents.
* Understand how information in clinical documentation relates to the corresponding billing information.
* Convert unstructured information from PDFs, scans and other documents into structured data.
* Detect missing information, inconsistencies, duplicate entries and potential billing discrepancies.
* Compare medical records and invoices to determine whether the documentation supports the billed services.
* Review data extracted automatically by AI systems and determine whether the results are correct.
* Identify recurring document structures and patterns that can be automated.
* Define rules, examples and edge cases that help our technical team improve document-processing and AI models.
* Create and maintain structured reference examples and validation datasets.
* Work with developers and AI specialists to test new extraction and classification workflows.
* Investigate cases where automated processing fails and explain why.
* Help design quality-control processes that allow AI-assisted workflows to operate reliably at scale.

**US medical billing knowledge**

For US documentation, relevant experience may include working with areas such as:

* Hospital and physician billing
* Itemized medical bills
* Explanation of Benefits documentation
* Medical coding and claims documentation
* ICD diagnosis information
* CPT and HCPCS procedure information
* Facility and professional charges
* Provider documentation
* Insurance claims and billing workflows

You do not necessarily need to be a certified medical coder, but you should be comfortable navigating complex medical and billing records and understanding how the different documents relate to one another.

**German medical billing knowledge**

For German documentation, relevant experience may include:

* Krankenhausrechnungen
* Arzt- und Facharztrechnungen
* Ambulante und stationäre Behandlungsunterlagen
* Entlassungsberichte
* Leistungsnachweise
* Diagnosen und Prozeduren
* GOÄ / GOZ billing
* EBM-related documentation
* DRG-related hospital documentation
* ICD-10-GM and OPS information
* Private and statutory healthcare billing processes

Experience does not need to cover every billing system. Deep practical knowledge of either the German or US healthcare billing environment is valuable.

**What we are looking for**

You could come from a number of professional backgrounds, including:

* Medical billing
* Medical coding
* Hospital billing departments
* Medical claims processing
* Healthcare administration
* Revenue cycle management
* Medical documentation
* Health insurance claims
* Medical auditing
* Clinical documentation review

The most important requirement is that you have
**hands-on experience working with real medical records and can confidently interpret complex documentation**
.

You should also:

* Be highly detail-oriented.
* Be comfortable reviewing large volumes of documents.
* Be able to identify relevant information quickly within long patient files.
* Understand that medical documentation is often incomplete, inconsistent or poorly structured.
* Be comfortable making structured decisions based on defined rules.
* Be able to explain why a particular extraction or classification is correct or incorrect.
* Be interested in technology and AI.
* Be comfortable working closely with technical teams.
* Have strong written English and/or German skills.

**Particularly valuable experience**

Experience in any of the following areas would be especially useful:

* Reviewing medical records for billing companies
* Medical bill auditing
* Revenue cycle management
* Coding quality assurance
* Claims review
* Insurance or reimbursement analysis
* Medical-legal record review
* Training or supervising medical billing teams
* Building SOPs for medical-document processing
* Working with OCR, document-processing or AI-assisted healthcare software

**The opportunity**

This is not simply a role for manually processing medical bills.

The objective is to take workflows that today require large teams of people reading documents page by page and determine how they can be transformed into a combination of:

**AI extraction → automated classification → structured validation → human review of exceptions**

The analyst plays a critical role in that process.

You bring the domain knowledge required to understand what the AI should extract, where mistakes typically occur, which decisions can be automated safely and where human judgment is still required.

Over time, the role can develop from reviewing individual cases into helping design the
**medical billing intelligence and quality-control systems**
that process them.

**Location**

Remote.

Candidates with experience in either the United States or German healthcare system are encouraged to apply. Experience across both systems is particularly valuable.

jobs.title: Research Engineer (Process)
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**
We are seeking a highly skilled Process & Chemical Engineer to lead the development, assessment, and scale-up of advanced treatment solutions for complex water, wastewater, and industrial effluents. The role combines deep chemical engineering fundamentals with strong process engineering capabilities to design, validate, and deploy innovative treatment solutions across physico-chemical, biological, thermal, membrane, and electrochemical domains.
  
  
The candidate will be responsible for conducting detailed treatability studies, developing integrated flowsheets, and implementing pilot- and field-scale systems for diverse industrial sectors including petrochemicals, refineries, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, and heavy manufacturing. The role requires a strong grasp of contaminant behaviour, reaction engineering, separation processes, and system optimization. The candidate will work across laboratory testing, simulation, bench-scale experimentation, and on-site troubleshooting to deliver high-value treatment strategies. Close collaboration with chemical, biological, thermal, desalination, and digital teams is essential to ensure end-to-end technology development and deployment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end treatability studies covering characterization, experimental design, optimization, and performance validation of water, wastewater, and industrial effluents.
* Develop integrated flow sheets using physico-chemical, chemical, biological, electro-chemical, membrane, and thermal processes based on effluent characteristics.
* Conduct lab-scale and pilot-scale experiments, analyze results, and refine process conditions for scale-up.
* Simulate and model processes using tools such as ASPEN Plus, HYSYS, GPS-X, or equivalent to support design and optimization.
* Work closely with technologists, mechanical engineers, and field teams to translate laboratory findings into deployable pilot systems and field-scale implementations.
* Evaluate external technologies (both mature and early-stage innovations) and assess their applicability, differentiation, and integration potential.
* Support ZLD, high-TDS effluent treatment, and industrial sludge management programs, including development of novel chemical/physical treatment strategies.
* Generate mass balance, energy balance, and kinetic models to inform design and scale-up decisions.
* Assist in techno-economic analyses, benchmarking, cost estimation, and feasibility assessments for treatment technologies.
* Prepare detailed engineering documents, SOPs, experimental logs, and technical reports for internal and external stakeholders.
* Collaborate with digital teams to incorporate data analytics, process monitoring, and modelling improvements.
* Contribute to publications, patents, and standardization initiatives emerging from successful R&D programs.
* Provide field troubleshooting support for treatment failures, optimization needs, or performance deviations at customer plants.

**Qualifications**

* Education: PhD or M.Tech in Chemical Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Biotechnology, Industrial Chemistry, or related disciplines.
* Experience: ~10 years total, with a minimum of 5 years in water, wastewater, or industrial effluent treatment.
* Strong knowledge of reaction engineering, separation processes, mass transfer, and water chemistry.
* Experience with lab-scale experimentation, pilot testing, and field implementation.
* Familiarity with process simulation tools (ASPEN, HYSYS, GPS-X, BioWin, or equivalent).
* Publications: Minimum 3–5 publications in peer-reviewed journals; patents or book chapters preferred.
* Strong analytical, communication, and technical documentation skills.
* Ability to work with cross-functional R&D teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

**Location**
Water Technology Centre, Kanchipuram, Tamil Nadu

* Support yeast strain selection, propagation, viability, vitality, and fermentation performance.

* Identify and help mitigate contamination through effective sterilization and CIP practices.
* Collaborate with customers and internal teams and share technical knowledge to help prevent recurring production challenges.

* A collaborative approach to technical problem-solving and knowledge sharing.
* A proactive approach to your work, with an interest in developing and implementing innovative technical solutions.

We are looking for a Quality Manager, Vendor Compliance to oversee supplier quality, food safety, and regulatory compliance across a network of ingredient suppliers, manufacturing partners, and fulfillment facilities. You will own the quality systems and processes that ensure materials and finished products consistently meet established standards. Working closely with Procurement, Regulatory, R&D, and Supply Chain, you will lead supplier qualification, audits, risk assessments, and corrective action programs. You will also manage ingredient verification, quality documentation, and supplier performance monitoring to identify and address potential issues proactively. This role combines hands-on quality oversight with strategic supplier partnerships and continuous improvement initiatives. You will contribute to a collaborative, fast-moving environment where product integrity, accountability, and consumer trust are essential.
  
  
**Accountabilities**
As Quality Manager, Vendor Compliance, you will take ownership of supplier quality programs and the systems used to maintain food safety, regulatory compliance, and reliable manufacturing standards. You will work across internal teams and external partners to identify risks, resolve quality issues, strengthen supplier performance, and ensure documentation remains accurate and audit-ready.
  
  

* Supplier Quality & Compliance

+ Own supplier qualification, approval, and compliance programs, ensuring suppliers and materials meet quality, food safety, regulatory, and business requirements.
+ Lead supplier and material onboarding in partnership with Procurement, Regulatory, R&D, and Supply Chain.
+ Establish and maintain risk-based supplier and ingredient assessments based on material risk, manufacturing processes, supplier performance, and historical quality data.
+ Lead supplier quality investigations, corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs), and escalations, ensuring root causes are identified and corrective actions are sustainable.
+ Ensure suppliers comply with established requirements, including supplier expectation guidelines, specifications, quality standards, and applicable regulations.
+ Lead supplier audits and facility assessments while driving continuous improvement through effective supplier partnerships.

+ Oversee ingredient retention sample and traceability programs to support investigations and supplier performance evaluations.

+ Ensure supplier compliance records remain complete, current, and audit-ready.

  To ensure implementing HACCP, ISO 22000, GMP, and HSE standards; conducting product inspections and maintaining quality records on regular timeframe.
* **Machine Utilization:**
  Machine efficiency utilization rate is continuously improved and achieved with less time usage and maximum output against capacity.
* **Machine Efficiency (OEE):**
  To ensure that the machinery on the factory floor is operative with minimum/ no breakdowns on co-ordination with maintenance team and ensure that the maximum efficiency is drawn from machine running time.
* **New Product Development:**
  Innovation of new recipes, in YoY with at least 15+ new products developments with commercial production capacity, and for market penetrations that supports commercial teams for evolving market demands.
* **Product stability and Ingredient Upgrading:**
  Ensure that carefully made products are available to service customer deliveries in line with the sales plan for Retail, HORECA and export sales lines.
* **Cost Optimizing:**
  Responsible for the preparation of CAPEX & OPEX budgets for the Food Processing plant.

**Qualification & Experience**

* Master’s Degree in Food Science Technology
* Minimum 10 years’ experience in poultry production with 3+ years managerial level
* Professional Certifications in advanced Food Hygiene, Food Safety, related to Poultry

jobs.location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
****Overview:****
Abu Dhabi
  
  
Inception42, a G42 company, is the region’s leading innovator of AI-powered domain-specific as well as industry-agnostic products, built on a rich heritage of research and development. Within the G42 ecosystem, Inception42 functions as the core intelligence layer – transforming data and compute infrastructure into real-world, applied AI solutions. Beyond its commercial endeavors, Inception42 is committed to creating positive societal impact. For more information, please visit www.inceptionai.ai
  
  
**Overview**
You will play a crucial part in pioneering research and development across various facets of AI, including but not limited to computer vision, natural language processing, and audio signal processing. Your work will involve the creation and optimization of cutting-edge AI algorithms and deep learning models, contributing to advancements in areas such as semantic understanding, multidimensional data interpretation, and human-machine interactions. Furthermore, your innovative efforts will be applied to a spectrum of practical use cases, serving pivotal industries such as finance, oil and gas, environmental science, and healthcare, thereby driving forward the frontier of impactful AI solutions in real-world scenarios.
  
  
****Responsibilities:****
What You’ll Own
  
  

* Engage in the design, analysis and optimization of foundational and applied research to power the state-of-the-art AI algorithms and model capabilities. This will involve staying well-informed of emerging trends, understanding and manipulating complex datasets, and conceptualizing models that are both innovative and applicable to real-world scenarios.
* Work on comprehensive solutions that integrate various modalities, including text, audio, and visual data, enhancing the AI's ability to understand and interpret human interaction in a more nuanced manner.
* Collaborate with researchers and engineers across teams for the design, development, and continual improvement of AI algorithms, ensuring the implementations of such algorithms are optimized for efficiency, reliability, and scalability.
* Work alongside product development teams to integrate new algorithms and models into broader product offerings, and conduct proofs of concept (POC) as per client needs, ensuring that these innovations translate into tangible benefits for users and stakeholders.
* Propose scenarios where AI techniques could improve the efficiency of the customer’s business.
* Provide pre-sales and post-sales technical support to the business development team.

Skills and attributes for success
  
  
The criteria for your success would include cost savings achieved, number of use cases investigated & datasets mined, number of innovations/POCs deployed, number of existing processes optimized, and customer NPS.
  
  
****Qualifications:****
What We’re Looking For
  
  

* M.Sc. or Ph.D. degree in computer science, engineering, or AI-related field. Specialization in Computer Vision, Natural Language Processing or Speech and Audio are highly desirable.
* Minimum 10 years of experience in developing AI algorithms for various modalities.
* Track record of conducting high-level research, preferably evidenced by publications in peer-reviewed journals or a history of product-driven research and development.

Ideally, you’ll also need
  
  

* A highly curious and inquisitive approach to problem-solving
* In-depth knowledge of the latest developments in AI and machine learning
* Excellent communication skills

Why Inception42
  
  
**Inception42 is building AI systems designed for practical deployment at scale — across industries, infrastructure, and national-level initiatives.**
If you want to work close to both advanced AI capability and real-world execution, we’d like to hear from you.

jobs.description:

At IFFCO Group, we are fully dedicated to our core value of "People" We are devoted to fostering our employees' growth, providing them with limitless opportunities for personal and career advancement. Our enticing benefits and inclusive work environment have garnered recognition as a certified Great Place to Work® in the UAE and Saudi Arabia.

**Empowerment Through Diversity: Crafting Your Journey at IFFCO Group**

Within IFFCO Group, every role—be it an internship, a graduate opportunity, or a job opening; offers you the autonomy to shape your professional trajectory. You'll encounter abundant prospects for personal and professional flourishing when collaborating with visionary brands and individuals driving our vision and business expansion. We believe that an entrepreneurial mindset drives success, and our dedicated workforce is the heartbeat of our achievements.

**Job Summary**

* Support in managing, coordinating and measuring regenerative agriculture impact projects. Olive oil value chain and other IFFCO key crops in short focus, palm – mid-term.
* Identify potential wildlife conservation projects in key markets: KSA, Egypt, Pakistan, Indonesia in focus. Co-develop the conservation projects proposal and execution of the approved projects with partners.
* Assess biodiversity conservation projects by suppliers in IFFCO key crops value chain.
* Work together with the communications team to leverage sustainability stories and results of projects.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Support developing targets and detailed time-bound action plan on regenerative agriculture and wildlife conservation projects, provide advice and support, execute coordination, and ensure the implementation.
* Focus: Regenerative agriculture practices introduced in 100% olive oil value chain and apply the learnings to other IFFCO key crops value chain. Potential wildlife conservation projects in key markets: KSA, Egypt, Pakistan and Indonesia.
* Work closely with partners, coordinate and manage regenerative agriculture. Support with internal communication decks around regenerative agriculture and impacts.
* Work closely with partners, direct and coordinate on wildlife conservation projects. Support with internal communication decks around wildlife conservation projects and impacts.
* Collect, compile, measure and report on progress and results of projects.
* Support in external communications of sustainability stories and results of projects.

*This is a not-exhaustive list of focus areas and tasks*

**KPIs**

* Committed Biodiversity targets reached, including communications on sustainability stories and impacts
* 100% Olive oil value chain is implementing regenerative agriculture and is reflected in the brands campaigns/communications. In plan, budget and time
* Regenerative agriculture learning applied and implemented in other IFFCO key crops
* IFFCO footprint on biodiversity conservation is realized
* Sustainability Team administrative support

**Work Experience Requirement**

Agricultural and environmental background. Sustainability aspects knowledge.

**Qualification**

University Graduates in Agriculture / Environment Science

**Competencies**

* Communicating effectively
* Customer Centricity
* Knowledge of Value Chain Management
* Manufacturing Operations and Industry Practices
* Ownership & Result Orientation
* Planning & Decision Making
* Project Management
* Self and Team Management

**Enriching Lives Since 1975: IFFCO Group's Legacy**

Since its establishment in 1975, IFFCO Group has thrived into a multinational conglomerate headquartered in the United Arab Emirates. Our influential FMCG brands and diverse portfolio of industry solutions and services enrich the lives of countless consumers and customers across the globe. In 2023, IFFCO Group proudly carries the distinction of being certified as a Great Place to Work® in both the UAE and Saudi Arabia.

jobs.title: Quality Specialist
jobs.description:
**About the Company**
Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.
  
  
Since 2012, Careem has enabled earnings for over 2.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of more than 70 million customers, and built a platform where the region’s best talent and entrepreneurs thrive. We operate in 70+ cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan.
  
  
***We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.***
**About The Team**
At Careem Quik, you will join a fast-moving team where quality carries real authority, and where the people on the ground have the final say on what reaches the customer.
  
  
**About The Role**
As Quality Specialist, you will set the quality and food safety standards for our fresh and ultra-fresh range, with a strong focus on Fruits & Vegetables, and lead the team that holds those standards across our dark stores and distribution centres.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own quality, food safety, and cold chain standards across our fresh and ultra-fresh range, with a strong focus on Fruits & Vegetables.
* Lead, train, and develop a team of quality controllers and supervisors across dark stores and distribution centres.
* Audit product freshness, storage, and handling regularly, and follow through on findings.
* Review refunds and customer complaints, lead root cause analyses, and put corrective and preventive actions in place.
* Evaluate supplier performance and work with Commercial and Supply Chain teams to hold suppliers to Careem’s standards.
* Report quality metrics and recommend improvements, including new tools and technologies.
* Maintain product specifications, checklists, and SOPs, and keep operations compliant with local food safety regulations and hygiene protocols.

**What You’ll Need**

* Minimum 3 to 5 years of experience in food quality or food safety, ideally in fresh produce, fresh grocery, retail, quick commerce, or food distribution.
* Experience managing quality control in warehouse, dark store, or fulfillment environments.
* Strong knowledge of the cold chain, HACCP, and UAE food safety standards. Advanced food safety certification is preferred.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience using data for root cause analysis.
* Ability to lead and train frontline teams, with strong communication and collaboration skills.

**What We’ll Provide You**
We offer colleagues the opportunity to drive impact in the region while they learn and grow. As a full time Careem colleague, you will be able to:
  
  

* Work and learn from great minds by joining a community of inspiring colleagues.
* Put your passion to work in a purposeful organisation dedicated to creating impact in a region with a lot of untapped potential.
* Explore new opportunities to learn and grow every day.
* Work 4 days a week in office & 1 day from home, and remotely from any country in the world for 30 days a year with unlimited vacation days per year. (If you are in an individual contributor role in tech, you will have 2 office days a week and 3 to work from home.)
* Access to healthcare benefits and fitness reimbursements for health activities including gym, health club, and training classes.
